* [OpenAI text generation](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text)
* [OpenAI error handling](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes)

# Legacy text completions

## Endpoint overview

`POST /v1/completions` accepts prompt and returns completion text, without messages, tool calls, or Responses output items. It is a legacy interface; prefer Chat Completions or Responses for new projects. Only models supporting this completion protocol can use it; an arbitrary chat model ID will not work.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. Direct OpenAI access uses `https://api.openai.com` and Bearer authentication, but requires an OpenAI key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

## Quick start

1. **Prepare configuration**\: create a key in API key management and copy a full model ID that supports legacy completions from Models and pricing.
2. **Send a minimal request**\: submit a single `prompt` and keep `stream` set to `false`; first confirm that authentication, the model, and parameters are valid.
3. **Read the result**\: the request succeeds only when HTTP is 2xx and `choices[]` is non-empty; the completion is in `choices[0].text`.
4. **Verify**\: check `finish_reason` and the actual content, then confirm against the usage logs.

```bash
API_URL="https://api.dwchainless.com/v1/completions"
API_KEY="PASTE_API_KEY_HERE"
curl "$API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "MODEL_ID",
    "prompt": "请补全这句话：机器学习是",
    "max_tokens": 64,
    "stream": false
  }'
```

Replace `PASTE_API_KEY_HERE` and `MODEL_ID` with real values; new projects should prefer Chat Completions or Responses.

## Request parameters

JSON request body.

| Field                                  | Type           | Required    | Description                                                                                                             |
| -------------------------------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                                  | string         | Yes         | A model ID supporting legacy completions.                                                                               |
| prompt                                 | string / array | Conditional | The text to complete; may also be multiple texts or token ID arrays. The examples use a string.                         |
| max\_tokens                            | integer        | No          | Maximum generated tokens; input and output together must fit the context window.                                        |
| stream                                 | boolean        | No          | true returns SSE; default false.                                                                                        |
| temperature / top\_p                   | number         | No          | Sampling control; usually adjust one.                                                                                   |
| n                                      | integer        | No          | Candidate completions per prompt.                                                                                       |
| stop                                   | string / array | No          | Up to four stop sequences; returned text excludes the stop string.                                                      |
| echo                                   | boolean        | No          | Whether to include the input prompt in returned text.                                                                   |
| logprobs                               | integer        | No          | Return log probabilities for candidate tokens, up to 5.                                                                 |
| presence\_penalty / frequency\_penalty | number         | No          | Repetition penalties, from -2 to 2.                                                                                     |
| suffix                                 | string         | No          | Only for models supporting insertion completions.                                                                       |
| best\_of                               | integer        | No          | Generate multiple candidates server-side and select the best; incompatible with stream and increases generation volume. |

### Request example

```json
{
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "prompt": "请补全这句话：机器学习是",
  "max_tokens": 64,
  "stream": false
}
```

## Response

| Field                                                     | Type             | Description                                                     |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id / object                                               | string           | Completion ID; object=text\_completion.                         |
| created / model                                           | integer / string | Unix-second timestamp and model.                                |
| choices\[].text                                           | string           | Completion result, not message.content.                         |
| choices\[].index                                          | integer          | Candidate index.                                                |
| choices\[].finish\_reason                                 | string           | stop, length, or content\_filter.                               |
| choices\[].logprobs                                       | object / null    | Token probability information; usually null when not requested. |
| usage.prompt\_tokens / completion\_tokens / total\_tokens | integer          | Input, generated, and total tokens.                             |

```json
{
  "id": "cmpl_example",
  "object": "text_completion",
  "created": 1760000000,
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "choices": [
    {
      "text": "一种从数据中学习规律的方法。",
      "index": 0,
      "logprobs": null,
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 12,
    "completion_tokens": 14,
    "total_tokens": 26
  }
}
```

For streaming, concatenate choices\[].text and end at `[DONE]`; merge separately by index for multiple prompts or candidates.

# Responses API

## Endpoint overview

`POST /v1/responses` uses input and output items rather than Chat choices/message, making it suitable for tools, multimodal content, and structured output.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. Direct OpenAI access uses `https://api.openai.com` and Bearer authentication, but requires an OpenAI key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

The gateway provides response creation, but no general `GET /v1/responses/{id}` or cancellation endpoint. Therefore, the native OpenAI asynchronous workflow with `background: true` is not supported through this integration; use synchronous requests or SSE. Background jobs require direct official integration with complete create, retrieve, and cancel capabilities.

## Quick start

1. **Prepare configuration**\: create a key in API key management and copy a full model ID that supports Responses from Models and pricing.
2. **Send a minimal request**\: pass a short text as `input` and keep `stream` set to `false`; first confirm that authentication, the model, and parameters are valid.
3. **Read the result**\: the request succeeds only when HTTP is 2xx and `status` is `completed`; the text is in the `output[].content[]` item where `type=output_text`.
4. **Verify**\: check `error`, `incomplete_details`, and the actual content, then confirm against the usage logs.

```bash
API_URL="https://api.dwchainless.com/v1/responses"
API_KEY="PASTE_API_KEY_HERE"
curl "$API_URL" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "MODEL_ID",
    "input": "用一句话解释机器学习。",
    "stream": false
  }'
```

Replace `PASTE_API_KEY_HERE` and `MODEL_ID` with real values; once it works, add tools or structured output, or enable streaming.

## Request parameters

The content type is `application/json`.

| Field                                                 | Type                     | Required    | Description                                                                                                                                                                         |
| ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ----------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                                                 | string                   | Yes         | Required for gateway calls; choose a Responses-compatible model.                                                                                                                    |
| input                                                 | string / array           | Conditional | Text or a list of input items; ordinary generation needs input, optionally with available historical context.                                                                       |
| input\[].role                                         | string                   | Conditional | Message role\: user, assistant, system, or developer.                                                                                                                               |
| input\[].content\[].type                              | string                   | Conditional | Typed content such as input\_text, input\_image, or input\_file.                                                                                                                    |
| input\[].content\[].text                              | string                   | Conditional | Text for type=input\_text.                                                                                                                                                          |
| input\[].content\[].image\_url                        | string                   | Conditional | An image URL or data URL for type=input\_image.                                                                                                                                     |
| input\[].content\[].file\_data / file\_url / file\_id | string                   | Conditional | Select one file source for type=input\_file; see file understanding.                                                                                                                |
| instructions                                          | string                   | No          | High-priority instructions; provide required instructions again when using previous\_response\_id.                                                                                  |
| max\_output\_tokens                                   | integer                  | No          | Maximum total output tokens, including reasoning tokens.                                                                                                                            |
| stream                                                | boolean                  | No          | true returns an SSE stream with typed events.                                                                                                                                       |
| previous\_response\_id                                | string                   | No          | Previous response ID; depends on retained upstream state and the same accessible context. Do not combine with conversation.                                                         |
| conversation                                          | string / object          | No          | Conversation object or ID; cannot be combined with previous\_response\_id. Availability depends on the channel.                                                                     |
| store                                                 | boolean                  | No          | Ask the upstream to store the response; not a gateway-log retention switch.                                                                                                         |
| tools / tool\_choice                                  | array / string or object | No          | Function or vendor-provided tools and selection rules.                                                                                                                              |
| parallel\_tool\_calls                                 | boolean                  | No          | Whether one response may include multiple function calls.                                                                                                                           |
| reasoning                                             | object                   | No          | Supported reasoning models can configure effort and summary; options vary by model.                                                                                                 |
| text.format                                           | object                   | No          | Text format such as type=json\_schema; differs from Chat response\_format.                                                                                                          |
| temperature / top\_p                                  | number                   | No          | Sampling parameters where supported by the model.                                                                                                                                   |
| truncation                                            | string                   | No          | Deprecated by OpenAI; prefer context\_management. disabled (default) errors when context is exceeded, while auto may drop some context. Gateway support depends on actual behavior. |
| include                                               | array                    | No          | Request additional data such as reasoning.encrypted\_content or web\_search\_call.action.sources.                                                                                   |
| metadata                                              | object                   | No          | Application correlation metadata; do not store sensitive information here.                                                                                                          |

Omit optional fields when not configured. `stop`, `enable_thinking` and similar compatibility extensions are not standard OpenAI Responses fields. `reasoning_content` is not a standard output field either. Reasoning uses a separate reasoning item and does not guarantee access to internal chain-of-thought.

### Request example

```json
{
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "input": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "用一句话解释什么是机器学习。"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "max_output_tokens": 256,
  "stream": false
}
```

## Response

A successful non-streaming request returns HTTP 200. Key fields are shown below; unused optional state fields may be null.

| Field                                                | Type             | Description                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id / object                                          | string           | Response ID; object=response.                                                                                                         |
| created\_at / model                                  | integer / string | Creation time in Unix seconds and model.                                                                                              |
| status                                               | string           | completed, incomplete, failed, queued, in\_progress, or cancelled; these states can appear in both streamed and background responses. |
| output\[]                                            | array            | Typed output items may mix message, reasoning, function\_call, web\_search\_call, and more; do not hard-code output\[0].              |
| output\[].type / id / status                         | string           | Output item type, ID, and status, where applicable.                                                                                   |
| output\[].role                                       | string           | Message output usually uses assistant.                                                                                                |
| output\[].content\[]                                 | array            | Message content items\: type=output\_text for text, type=refusal for refusals.                                                        |
| output\[].content\[].text / annotations              | string / array   | Response text and annotations such as citations.                                                                                      |
| output\[].call\_id / name / arguments                | string           | The function\_call correlation ID, name, and JSON-string arguments.                                                                   |
| error                                                | object / null    | Failure information; usually null on normal completion.                                                                               |
| incomplete\_details                                  | object / null    | The incomplete reason, such as max\_output\_tokens; do not treat it as complete success.                                              |
| usage.input\_tokens / output\_tokens / total\_tokens | integer          | Input, output, and total tokens.                                                                                                      |
| usage.\*\_tokens\_details                            | object           | Optional usage details such as caching and reasoning.                                                                                 |

```json
{
  "id": "resp_example",
  "object": "response",
  "created_at": 1760000000,
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "status": "completed",
  "error": null,
  "incomplete_details": null,
  "output": [
    {
      "id": "msg_example",
      "type": "message",
      "role": "assistant",
      "status": "completed",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "output_text",
          "text": "机器学习让计算机从数据中学习规律，用于预测和决策。",
          "annotations": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "input_tokens": 18,
    "output_tokens": 22,
    "total_tokens": 40
  }
}
```

To extract text, iterate through `output` for items of `type=message` and concatenate the text in their `content` under `type=output_text`. The SDK’s `output_text` is a convenience aggregation property, not a required field in raw REST JSON.

### Streaming responses

With stream=true, parse SSE `event` and `data`\: response.created creates the response; response.output\_text.delta appends text; response.output\_item.added/done manage output items; response.function\_call\_arguments.delta assembles tool arguments. Only response.completed plus the final response.status establishes complete success. Handle response.failed, response.incomplete, and error separately; network EOF alone does not mean success.

```text
event: response.output_text.delta
data: {"type":"response.output_text.delta","item_id":"msg_example","output_index":0,"content_index":0,"delta":"机器学习","sequence_number":3}

event: response.completed
data: {"type":"response.completed","response":{"id":"resp_example","object":"response","status":"completed","output":[]},"sequence_number":12}
```

## Code examples

Set `SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`, `SIMIROUTER_MODEL`; `SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL` overrides the default gateway root; do not append `/v1`. Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use only standard libraries. The curl example uses Python 3 to encode JSON safely.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY")
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_MODEL"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL")
    base = os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL", "https://api.dwchainless.com").rstrip("/")
    body = json.loads(r'''{
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "input": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": [
            {
              "type": "input_text",
              "text": "用一句话解释什么是机器学习。"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "max_output_tokens": 256,
      "stream": false
    }''')
    body["model"] = os.environ["SIMIROUTER_MODEL"]
    path = '/v1/responses'
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        print(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode()}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY) throw new Error('请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY');
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_MODEL) throw new Error('请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL');
      const base = (
        process.env.SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL || 'https://api.dwchainless.com'
      ).replace(/\/$/, '');
      const body = {
        model: 'MODEL_ID',
        input: [
          {
            role: 'user',
            content: [
              {
                type: 'input_text',
                text: '用一句话解释什么是机器学习。',
              },
            ],
          },
        ],
        max_output_tokens: 256,
        stream: false,
      };
      body.model = process.env.SIMIROUTER_MODEL;
      const endpoint = '/v1/responses';
      const response = await fetch(base + endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {
          Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}`,
          'Content-Type': 'application/json',
        },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000),
      });
      const result = await response.text();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${result}`);
      console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(result), null, 2));
    }
    main().catch((error) => {
      console.error(error);
      process.exitCode = 1;
    });
    ```
  </Tab>

    ```go
    package main

    import (
      "bytes"
      "fmt"
      "io"
      "log"
      "net/http"
      "os"
      "strings"
      "time"
      "encoding/json"
    )

    func main() {
      key := os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"); if key == "" { log.Fatal("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY") }
      model := os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_MODEL"); if model == "" { log.Fatal("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL") }
      base := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL"), "/"); if base == "" { base = "https://api.dwchainless.com" }
      var body map[string]any
      if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "input": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": [
            {
              "type": "input_text",
              "text": "用一句话解释什么是机器学习。"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "max_output_tokens": 256,
      "stream": false
    }`), &body); err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      body["model"] = model
      endpoint := "/v1/responses"
      payload, err := json.Marshal(body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", base + endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload)); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 120 * time.Second}
      response, err := client.Do(req); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; defer response.Body.Close()
      result, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      if response.StatusCode >= 400 { log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, result) }
      fmt.Println(string(result))
    }
    ```
  </Tab>

## Errors

| HTTP status | Meaning or vendor error type           | Action                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400         | Invalid request                        | Check required fields, JSON, model parameters, and context length.                                               |
| 401         | Authentication failed                  | Check that the key exists, is valid, and belongs to the correct service.                                         |
| 403 / 404   | Access denied / resource not found     | Check model permissions, resource IDs, and the URL.                                                              |
| 429         | Rate or quota limit                    | Distinguish rate limits from insufficient quota using the response body; retrying cannot fix insufficient quota. |
| 500 / 503   | Server error / temporarily unavailable | Retain the request identifier and use bounded backoff for transient failures.                                    |

Native OpenAI errors usually contain `error.message`, `error.type`, `error.param`, `error.code`; `param`, `code` may be `null`; do not assume these fields always exist or equal the HTTP status. The gateway may return authentication, routing, or quota errors before contacting the vendor; the status alone does not establish an upstream error. Even under HTTP 200, inspect status, error, and incomplete\_details; SSE failure events may not change an HTTP status already sent.

Long replies and streaming requests can take from tens of seconds to several minutes; set a sufficient client timeout, and when the stream breaks, judge from the deltas received and the termination reason instead of resending automatically. For 429 and 5xx, inspect the response body and usage logs first; when content policy rejects a request, change the prompt or input rather than retrying unchanged.

## Official reference

* [OpenAI Responses API](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses/methods/create)
* [OpenAI streaming events](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/streaming-responses)
* [OpenAI conversation state](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/conversation-state)
* [OpenAI background mode](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/background)
* [OpenAI error handling](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes)

# Music (unsupported)

This section documents Google Lyria’s public generation protocol. SimiRouter has not yet opened music capabilities; all examples connect directly to the Google AI Studio Gemini API using `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com` and a Google API key. Vertex AI requires a separate protocol that is not verified on this page; do not substitute its address directly.

## Overview

| Capability               | Input                                           | Output                                                        | Status of this section |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------- |
| Generate a music clip    | Text description or an image                    | About 30 seconds of audio, MP3 by default                     | Official API reference |
| Generate a complete song | Prompt with verse and chorus descriptions       | A song of several minutes, possibly with lyrics and structure | Official API reference |
| Realtime performance     | Continuously sent prompts and playback controls | Continuous PCM audio chunks                                   | Official API reference |

## Core concepts

* **Clip vs. song**\: clips are fixed at 30 seconds and suit previews and loops; songs take their length and structure from the prompt, so duration is not an exact guarantee.
* **Realtime session**\: a bidirectional WebSocket that accepts continuous prompts and PLAY or PAUSE controls while connected; it is not a one-shot request with a stream switch.
* **Audio format**\: MP3 by default, WAV on request; the realtime endpoint returns raw PCM chunks that the application must buffer and wrap itself.
* **Keys and addresses**\: examples on this page use only the Google AI Studio Gemini API address and a Google API key; SimiRouter does not proxy music models, and Vertex AI’s separate protocol is not verified here.

Duration caps, sample rates, and bit rates depend on the model; see the parameter tables in [Lyria](/simidoc/en/apps/api/music/lyria) and [RealTime](/simidoc/en/apps/api/music/realtime).

## Endpoint overview

| Mode                      | Official protocol           | Capability                                                      | Documentation                     |
| ------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------- |
| One-shot music generation | `POST /v1beta/interactions` | Generate clips or complete songs from text or images            | [Lyria music generation](/simidoc/en/apps/api/music/lyria) |
| Realtime music            | Bidirectional WebSocket     | Continuously generate and dynamically adjust instrumental audio | [Lyria RealTime](/simidoc/en/apps/api/music/realtime)      |

Lyria Clip generates 30-second clips; Lyria 3.5 targets more complete songs. RealTime is experimental and uses a persistent connection, not the Interactions stream switch. Music models do not read ordinary text aloud; for TTS, use [Audio](/simidoc/en/apps/api/audio).

## Simulated call

Official one-shot Google generation uses Interactions, with the request describing style and structure\:

```json
{
  "model": "lyria-3-clip-preview",
  "input": "温暖的钢琴与弦乐，节奏舒缓，适合纪录片开场"
}
```

The audio in the response is Base64, not a download URL\:

```json
{
  "steps": [
    {
      "type": "model_output",
      "content": [
        { "type": "text", "text": "[Instrumental]" },
        { "type": "audio", "data": "<Base64音频>" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Audio and text items can interleave, so walk `content[]` by `type`; taking only the last item drops lyrics or structural notes.

## Authentication and rights

Google’s official Interactions API uses `x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY`; realtime connections use the official SDK or WebSocket protocol. Generated content remains subject to Google’s terms, copyright, and voice-authorization requirements. Model availability, regions, and quotas depend on the Google account.

## Official reference

[Google music generation](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/music-generation), [Realtime music](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/realtime-music-generation).

# Google Lyria music generation

The pages below follow the official Google API. SimiRouter has not yet opened this capability, so all examples connect directly to the Google AI Studio Gemini API using `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com` and a Google API key. Vertex AI requires a separate protocol that is not verified on this page; do not substitute its address directly.

## Endpoint overview

`POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions` with authentication `x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY`. Lyria uses Interactions, not generateContent or `/audio/speech`.

| Model                  | Purpose                                  | Duration and output                                                                 |
| ---------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `lyria-3-clip-preview` | Clips, loops, and quick previews         | Fixed 30 seconds; MP3 by default.                                                   |
| `lyria-3.5`            | Songs with verses, choruses, and bridges | Prompt-controlled songs lasting several minutes; MP3 by default, with optional WAV. |

## Request parameters

| Field                      | Type           | Required    | Description                                                               |
| -------------------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                      | string         | Yes         | One of the Lyria models above.                                            |
| input                      | string / array | Yes         | A music description or a text/image multimodal content array.             |
| input\[].text              | string         | Conditional | Style, tempo, mood, instruments, lyrics, and structure.                   |
| input\[].mime\_type / data | string         | Conditional | Image input uses an image item with its actual MIME type and Base64 data. |
| response\_format           | object         | No          | \{"type"\:"audio"} can request WAV; inspect the actual MIME type.         |

Do not treat duration control as an exact guarantee. Describing style and instrumentation is safer than requesting imitation of a particular singer.

## Response

| Field                                    | Description                                                                 |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id` / `status`                          | Interaction identifier and processing status.                               |
| `steps[].content[]`                      | model\_output contains audio, lyrics, and song structure; parse every item. |
| Audio item `type` / `mime_type` / `data` | type=audio; data is Base64, not a URL.                                      |
| Text item `text`                         | Lyrics, structure, or other text content.                                   |

The SDK’s `output_audio` / `output_text` are convenience properties. For complex interleaved results, iterate through steps rather than reading only the final part and omitting content. Response excerpt\:

```json
{"steps":[{"type":"model_output","content":[{"type":"text","text":"[Instrumental]"},{"type":"audio","mime_type":"audio/mpeg","data":"<Base64音频>"}]}]}
```

## Code examples

Python examples require `python3 -m pip install requests`; Node.js uses version 18+ with built-in fetch; Go uses standard libraries.

Set `GEMINI_API_KEY`. The example receives JSON and decodes audio-item data to an MP3 file. Change model to `lyria-3.5` to generate complete songs.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import os
    import requests

    url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions'
    headers = {'x-goog-api-key': '' + os.environ['GEMINI_API_KEY'], 'Api-Revision': '2026-05-20'}
    response = requests.request('POST', url, headers=headers, json={'model': 'lyria-3-clip-preview', 'input': '30秒温暖的原声吉他纯音乐，轻柔节拍，不要人声。'}, timeout=180)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.text)
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions";
      const headers = { "x-goog-api-key": "" + process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY, "Api-Revision": "2026-05-20" };
      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
      const body = JSON.stringify({
      "model": "lyria-3-clip-preview",
      "input": "30秒温暖的原声吉他纯音乐，轻柔节拍，不要人声。"
    });
      const response = await fetch(url, { method: "POST", headers, body, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180000) });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
      console.log(await response.text());
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```
  </Tab>

    ```bash
        "model": "lyria-3-clip-preview",
    ```

    ```go
    package main

    import (
      "fmt"
      "io"
      "net/http"
      "os"
      "time"
      "strings"
    )

    func check(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
    func main() {
      body := strings.NewReader(`{
      "model": "lyria-3-clip-preview",
      "input": "30秒温暖的原声吉他纯音乐，轻柔节拍，不要人声。"
    }`)
      req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions", body); check(err)
      req.Header.Set("x-goog-api-key", "" + os.Getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY"))
      req.Header.Set("Api-Revision", "2026-05-20")
      req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 180 * time.Second}
      res, err := client.Do(req); check(err)
      defer res.Body.Close()
      data, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body); check(err)
      if res.StatusCode < 200 || res.StatusCode >= 300 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", res.StatusCode, data)) }
      fmt.Println(string(data))
    }
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status           | Meaning and action                                                                                                                   |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 400                   | Invalid request fields or model parameters; correct the request before resubmitting.                                                 |
| 401                   | Missing, invalid, or expired API key.                                                                                                |
| 403                   | No access to the project or model.                                                                                                   |
| 404                   | Model or route not found; check the address and model ID.                                                                            |
| 429                   | Rate or quota limit; distinguish insufficient funds from retryable throttling.                                                       |
| 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 | Service or upstream failure. Keep the request ID and back off for temporary faults; do not retry the same paid request indefinitely. |

Google error objects use `error.code`, `error.status`, and `error.message`; never infer the source from the HTTP number alone. This endpoint is synchronous\: there is no task ID or polling stage. Never decode error text as audio data.

## Official reference

[Google Lyria music generation](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/music-generation), [Interactions](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/interactions).

# Lyria RealTime music

The pages below follow the official Google API. SimiRouter has not yet opened this capability, so all examples connect directly to the Google AI Studio Gemini API using `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com` and a Google API key. Vertex AI requires a separate protocol that is not verified on this page; do not substitute its address directly.

## Endpoint overview

Connect to `wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateMusic?key=$GEMINI_API_KEY` with model `models/lyria-realtime-exp`. This is a stateful bidirectional WebSocket, not HTTP POST, SSE, or Lyria 3.5 Interactions.

## Request parameters

Set only one top-level event per message. After connecting, send setup and wait for setupComplete before sending music prompts and playback controls.

| Field                                                         | Type             | Required | Description                                                             |
| ------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| setup.model                                                   | string           | Yes      | models/lyria-realtime-exp; send only in the connection’s first message. |
| clientContent.weightedPrompts                                 | object\[]        | Yes      | At least one text/weight pair; weights cannot all be zero.              |
| musicGenerationConfig.bpm                                     | integer          | No       | 60–200; changes require RESET\_CONTEXT or restarting playback.          |
| musicGenerationConfig.guidance                                | number           | No       | 0–6; default 4.                                                         |
| musicGenerationConfig.density / brightness                    | number           | No       | 0–1; note density and brightness.                                       |
| musicGenerationConfig.temperature / topK                      | number / integer | No       | 0–3 / 1–1000.                                                           |
| musicGenerationConfig.seed                                    | integer          | No       | Random seed.                                                            |
| musicGenerationConfig.scale                                   | string           | No       | An official Scale enum; changing scale requires resetting context.      |
| musicGenerationConfig.muteBass / muteDrums / onlyBassAndDrums | boolean          | No       | Bass/drum controls.                                                     |
| musicGenerationConfig.musicGenerationMode                     | string           | No       | QUALITY, DIVERSITY, or an experimentally supported mode.                |
| playbackControl                                               | string           | Yes      | PLAY, PAUSE, STOP, RESET\_CONTEXT.                                      |

## Response

* `setupComplete`\: subsequent messages can now be sent.
* `serverContent.audioChunks[].data`\: Base64 audio chunks in JSON; decode and concatenate raw samples.
* `audioChunks[].mimeType`\: the audio type; do not assume MP3/WAV.
* `filteredPrompt`\: why a prompt was filtered; `warning` is a warning and does not necessarily terminate the session.

The fixed specification is 16-bit, 48 kHz, stereo PCM; `audioChunks[].mimeType` identifies the response audio type and does not change the sample rate. Generation can be faster than playback, so applications must buffer, prevent clipping, and implement playback. The sample below saves `music.pcm` without pretending it is a WAV file with a header.

## Code examples

Set Google `GEMINI_API_KEY`. Python requires `websockets`, Node.js requires `ws`, and Go requires `github.com/gorilla/websocket`. Examples connect for at most 30 seconds and may incur inference charges; they do not integrate microphone or playback devices.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import asyncio
    import base64
    import json
    import os
    from pathlib import Path
    from websockets.asyncio.client import connect

    received_chunks = 0

    async def main():
        global received_chunks
        if not os.environ.get("GEMINI_API_KEY"):
            raise RuntimeError("请设置 GEMINI_API_KEY")
        if Path("music.pcm").exists():
            raise RuntimeError("music.pcm 已存在，请先选择新的输出文件名")
        url = "wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateMusic?key=" + os.environ["GEMINI_API_KEY"]
        async with connect(url, open_timeout=20, max_size=None) as ws:
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"setup":{"model":"models/lyria-realtime-exp"}}))
            while True:
                event = json.loads(await ws.recv())
                if "error" in event:
                    raise RuntimeError(event["error"])
                if "setupComplete" in event:
                    break
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"clientContent":{"weightedPrompts":[{"text":"minimal techno","weight":1.0}]}}))
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"musicGenerationConfig":{"bpm":90}}))
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"playbackControl":"PLAY"}))
            with Path("music.pcm").open("xb") as output:
                while True:
                    event = json.loads(await ws.recv())
                    if "error" in event:
                        raise RuntimeError(event["error"])
                    if "filteredPrompt" in event:
                        raise RuntimeError(event["filteredPrompt"])
                    for chunk in event.get("serverContent",{}).get("audioChunks",[]):
                        print("MIME:", chunk.get("mimeType"))
                        decoded = base64.b64decode(chunk["data"], validate=True)
                        if decoded:
                            output.write(decoded)
                            received_chunks += 1

    try:
        asyncio.run(asyncio.wait_for(main(), 30))
    except TimeoutError:
        if received_chunks == 0:
            raise RuntimeError("采样窗口内未收到音频，会话未成功")
        print(f"30 秒采样结束，已保存 {received_chunks} 个音频块；这不是模型自然终态。")
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    const WebSocket = require("ws");
    const { createWriteStream, existsSync } = require("node:fs");
    if (!process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY) throw new Error("请设置 GEMINI_API_KEY");
    if (existsSync("music.pcm")) throw new Error("music.pcm 已存在，请先选择新的输出文件名");
    const output = createWriteStream("music.pcm", {flags:"wx"});
    let receivedChunks = 0;
    const ws = new WebSocket("wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateMusic?key=" + process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY);
    let ready = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { ws.close(); output.end(); }, 30000);
    ws.on("open", () => ws.send(JSON.stringify({setup:{model:"models/lyria-realtime-exp"}})));
    ws.on("message", raw => {
      try {
        const event = JSON.parse(raw.toString());
        if (event.error || event.filteredPrompt) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(event.error || event.filteredPrompt));
        if (event.setupComplete && !ready) {
          ready = true;
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({clientContent:{weightedPrompts:[{text:"minimal techno",weight:1}]}}));
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({musicGenerationConfig:{bpm:90}}));
          ws.send(JSON.stringify({playbackControl:"PLAY"}));
        }
        for (const chunk of event.serverContent?.audioChunks || []) {
          console.log("MIME:", chunk.mimeType);
          const data = Buffer.from(chunk.data,"base64");
          if (data.length) { output.write(data); receivedChunks++; }
        }
      } catch (error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; ws.close(); }
    });
    ws.on("error", error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; });
    ws.on("close", () => {
      clearTimeout(timer); output.end();
      if (!receivedChunks) { console.error("会话关闭前未收到音频"); process.exitCode=1; }
    });
    output.on("error", error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; ws.close(); });
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="curl">
    ```text
    cURL 命令行不能完成持续的双向 WebSocket 音乐会话。
    请使用本页 Python、Node.js 或 Go 示例，不要用普通 POST 伪造音乐流。
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Go">
    ```go
    package main
    import (
      "encoding/base64"
      "encoding/json"
      "fmt"
      "net/url"
      "os"
      "time"
      "github.com/gorilla/websocket"
    )
    func check(err error) { if err!=nil {panic(err)} }
    func main() {
      if os.Getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY")=="" {panic("请设置 GEMINI_API_KEY")}
      endpoint := "wss://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/ws/google.ai.generativelanguage.v1beta.GenerativeService.BidiGenerateMusic?key="+url.QueryEscape(os.Getenv("GEMINI_API_KEY"))
      dialer:=websocket.Dialer{HandshakeTimeout:20*time.Second}
      ws,_,err:=dialer.Dial(endpoint,nil);check(err);defer ws.Close()
      check(ws.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(30*time.Second)))
      check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]any{"setup":map[string]string{"model":"models/lyria-realtime-exp"}}))
      file,err:=os.OpenFile("music.pcm",os.O_CREATE|os.O_EXCL|os.O_WRONLY,0600);check(err);defer file.Close()
      receivedChunks:=0
      ready:=false
      for {
        _,raw,err:=ws.ReadMessage(); if err!=nil {
          if networkErr,ok:=err.(interface{Timeout()bool});ok&&networkErr.Timeout()&&receivedChunks>0 {fmt.Println("采样窗口结束，已收到音频块",receivedChunks);return};panic(err)
        }
        var event map[string]json.RawMessage;check(json.Unmarshal(raw,&event))
        if value,ok:=event["error"];ok {panic(string(value))}
        if value,ok:=event["filteredPrompt"];ok {panic(string(value))}
        if _,ok:=event["setupComplete"];ok&&!ready {
          ready=true
          check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]any{"clientContent":map[string]any{"weightedPrompts":[]any{map[string]any{"text":"minimal techno","weight":1}}}}))
          check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]any{"musicGenerationConfig":map[string]any{"bpm":90}}))
          check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]any{"playbackControl":"PLAY"}))
        }
        if value,ok:=event["serverContent"];ok {
          var content struct {AudioChunks []struct {Data string `json:"data"`; MIME string `json:"mimeType"`} `json:"audioChunks"`}
          check(json.Unmarshal(value,&content))
          for _,chunk:=range content.AudioChunks {data,err:=base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(chunk.Data);check(err);_,err=file.Write(data);check(err);if len(data)>0 {receivedChunks++};fmt.Println(chunk.MIME)}
        }
      }
    }
    ```
  </Tab>

## Errors

Handshake HTTP 400/401/403 indicates URL, key, permission, or model issues; 429 indicates quota/rate limits. After connection, errors appear in error, filteredPrompt, warning, and WebSocket close codes/reasons. 1000 is a normal close; an abnormal disconnect does not guarantee cancellation or billing cessation. Reconnecting requires setup again; do not assume the previous session remains.

## Official reference

[Google realtime music](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/realtime-music-generation), [Live Music WebSocket API](https\://ai.google.dev/api/live_music).

# Gemini-format model list

## Endpoint overview

`GET /v1beta/models` returns a Gemini-format model list.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY` . Direct Google access uses `https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com`, usually with `x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY`, not the gateway Bearer key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

The gateway list primarily discovers model names; it is not Google’s complete native capability catalog.

## Request parameters

Gateway list requests have no body and require no pagination parameters. Native Google models.list supports pageSize (default 50, maximum 1,000) and pageToken, but the gateway returns the full list without identical pagination or metadata guarantees.

| Field                | Type                   | Required        | Description                                                                     |
| -------------------- | ---------------------- | --------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Authorization        | header string          | Yes             | Bearer gateway key; use a Google key for official direct access.                |
| pageSize / pageToken | query integer / string | Native optional | Pagination for the official native list only; do not depend on gateway support. |

## Response

| Field                                        | Type           | Description                                                                                          |
| -------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| models                                       | array          | The model list, which may be empty.                                                                  |
| models\[].name                               | string         | Model resource name; usually models/\{id} officially, but the gateway may return the plain model ID. |
| models\[].displayName                        | string         | Human-readable name.                                                                                 |
| nextPageToken                                | string / null  | Official next-page token; the gateway may return null when not paginated.                            |
| models\[].version / description              | string / null  | Version and description available officially; gateway values may be absent or null.                  |
| models\[].inputTokenLimit / outputTokenLimit | integer / null | Official input and output limits; do not infer values from missing fields.                           |
| models\[].supportedGenerationMethods         | array / null   | Official supported method names such as generateContent; gateway values may be absent or null.       |

```json
{
  "models": [
    {
      "name": "MODEL_ID",
      "displayName": "MODEL_ID"
    }
  ],
  "nextPageToken": null
}
```

The example above shows the gateway’s reduced structure. Before using name in a path, strip only one leading models/. A successful models.list does not guarantee generateContent access\: permissions, capabilities, or quotas may still cause failure.

## Code examples

Set `SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. To override the default gateway root, set `SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL` without a version suffix. All examples send a GET request without a body.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY")
    base = os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL", "https://api.dwchainless.com").rstrip("/")
    path = '/v1beta/models'
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, method="GET",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        print(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode()}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY");
      const base = (process.env.SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL || "https://api.dwchainless.com").replace(/\/$/, "");
      const endpoint = "/v1beta/models";
      const response = await fetch(base + endpoint, { method: "GET",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000) });
      const result = await response.text();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${result}`);
      console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(result), null, 2));
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="curl">
    ```bash
    set -eu
    : "${SIMIROUTER_API_KEY:?请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}"
    BASE_URL="${SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL:-https://api.dwchainless.com}"
    curl "${BASE_URL%/}/v1beta/models" \
      --fail-with-body \

      -H "Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"
    ```

    ```go
    package main

    import (
      "fmt"
      "io"
      "log"
      "net/http"
      "os"
      "strings"
      "time"
    )

    func main() {
      key := os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"); if key == "" { log.Fatal("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY") }
      base := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL"), "/"); if base == "" { base = "https://api.dwchainless.com" }
      endpoint := "/v1beta/models"
      req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", base + endpoint, nil); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 120 * time.Second}
      response, err := client.Do(req); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; defer response.Body.Close()
      result, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      if response.StatusCode >= 400 { log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, result) }
      fmt.Println(string(result))
    }
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status | Meaning or vendor error type          | Action                                                                          |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400         | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` and similar errors | Check JSON, model parameters, media MIME type, and input length.                |
| 403         | `PERMISSION_DENIED`                   | Check the key, project permissions, region, or billing restrictions.            |
| 404         | `NOT_FOUND`                           | Check the model name and API version.                                           |
| 429         | `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`                  | Check rate limits and quotas; use bounded backoff when retrying is appropriate. |
| 500 / 503   | `INTERNAL` / `UNAVAILABLE`            | Record the request identifier and retry a limited number of times or later.     |

Google’s native error object contains `error.code` (HTTP number), `error.status` (enum name), and `error.message`, optionally with `details`. The gateway may return authentication, routing, or quota errors before contacting the vendor; an HTTP number alone does not establish an upstream error. Internal gateway lookups may also return HTTP 200 with success=false; inspect the response structure.

## Official reference

* [Google Models API](https\://ai.google.dev/api/models)
* [Google model catalog](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models)
* [Google troubleshooting](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/troubleshooting)

# Model lists

Model lists help configure an integration\: obtain the model ID, then consult vendor capabilities to choose chat, vision, image, audio, or tool endpoints. Visibility does not guarantee callability, and a model list is not a realtime health check.

## Overview

| What you need to confirm               | Where to look                                        | Note                                                                         |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Which model IDs exist                  | The list endpoints in this section                   | Returns only models visible to the current credentials                       |
| Whether a model can actually be called | Models and pricing plus one real request             | Visible, routable, and funded are three different things                     |
| Which inputs and outputs it supports   | Model capability documentation                       | List metadata is usually incomplete                                          |
| When it shuts down                     | The vendor’s official deprecation or shutdown notice | Deprecation is not immediate unavailability, but do not add new integrations |

## Core concepts

* **Model ID**\: the unique identifier used in request bodies. It is usually case-sensitive and must be copied in full without abbreviating. Display names, aliases, and the actual request ID may differ.
* **Visible vs. callable**\: the list only reflects models within your permissions; requests still fail when a channel is unconfigured, the balance is insufficient, or rate limits apply.
* **Context window**\: the input-plus-output Token limit, per model; list endpoints often do not return it.
* **Billing unit**\: text models mostly bill per Token, image models per image or per Token, video models per second or per request; it can differ even within one model family.
* **Shutdown date**\: the date the vendor plans to stop serving. Migration should finish before that date, not be discovered after it.

## List endpoints

| Documentation             | Request            | Response structure                           |
| ------------------------- | ------------------ | -------------------------------------------- |
| [OpenAI format](/simidoc/en/apps/api/models/openai) | GET /v1/models     | data\[].id, for OpenAI-compatible clients.   |
| [Gemini format](/simidoc/en/apps/api/models/gemini) | GET /v1beta/models | models\[].name, for Gemini-protocol clients. |

## Request mode

Listing is a synchronous JSON request, not SSE or an asynchronous task. Different accounts may query concurrently, but credentials and results must remain separate. Expire cached lists and refresh when models become unavailable; do not send actual generation requests merely to refresh a list.

## Simulated call

Send a GET request with no body. This example shows a SimiRouter gateway response\:

```bash
curl "https://api.dwchainless.com/v1/models" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"
```

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "MODEL_ID",
      "object": "model",
      "created": 1626777600,
      "owned_by": "custom",
      "context_length": 1048576,
      "supported_endpoint_types": ["openai"]
    }
  ]
}
```

The gateway returns a context length and endpoint types. The length may be a platform default. Check the model documentation for pricing, input and output modalities, and tool support. An empty list usually means no models are visible to the current credentials.

## Metadata boundaries

OpenAI model objects contain id, object, created, and owned\_by; native Google objects may include methods and token limits. The gateway may return reduced metadata, so missing fields do not justify guessing context limits, modalities, or tool support.

## Official reference

* [OpenAI Models API](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/models/methods/list)
* [Google Models API](https\://ai.google.dev/api/models)

# OpenAI-format model list

## Endpoint overview

`GET /v1/models` returns models visible to the current key. It can populate a model selector, but does not establish all modalities, tools, quota availability, or current service health.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. Direct OpenAI access uses `https://api.openai.com` and Bearer authentication, but requires an OpenAI key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

Send only Bearer authentication; do not mix x-api-key or x-goog-api-key, which may trigger another gateway response format.

## Request parameters

This list request has no JSON body or required query parameters.

| Field         | Type          | Required | Description                   |
| ------------- | ------------- | -------- | ----------------------------- |
| Authorization | header string | Yes      | The gateway key after Bearer. |

## Response

| Field                             | Type                   | Description                                                                                                                                                    |
| --------------------------------- | ---------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| object                            | string                 | list.                                                                                                                                                          |
| data                              | array                  | The model list, which may be empty.                                                                                                                            |
| data\[].id                        | string                 | The model ID used in generation requests.                                                                                                                      |
| data\[].object                    | string                 | model.                                                                                                                                                         |
| data\[].created                   | integer                | Unix-second timestamp; gateway metadata may not reflect the vendor’s model release date.                                                                       |
| data\[].owned\_by                 | string                 | An ownership label; it does not prove routing to a particular vendor.                                                                                          |
| success                           | boolean                | An optional gateway business-result flag, not an OpenAI standard field.                                                                                        |
| `data[].context_length`           | integer                | Context length in tokens reported by the gateway. The platform default applies when no value is configured. Check the model documentation and endpoint limits. |
| `data[].supported_endpoint_types` | `array<string>` / null | Endpoint types reported by the gateway. Use them as a guide when selecting an endpoint.                                                                        |

```json
{
  "object": "list",
  "success": true,
  "data": [
    {
      "id": "MODEL_ID",
      "object": "model",
      "created": 1626777600,
      "owned_by": "custom",
      "context_length": 1048576,
      "supported_endpoint_types": ["openai"]
    }
  ]
}
```

An empty array is valid; do not access data\[0] without checking. A failed gateway group lookup may return HTTP 200 with success=false/message; clients must detect this application-level failure. Official OpenAI also provides GET /v1/models/\{model}; list metadata is not a complete capability description.

    ```bash
    : "${SIMIROUTER_API_KEY:?请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}"
    BASE_URL="${SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL:-https://api.dwchainless.com}"
    curl "${BASE_URL%/}/v1/models" \
      --fail-with-body \
      --max-time 120 \
      -X GET \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Go">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
      "fmt"
      "io"
      "log"
      "net/http"
      "os"
      "strings"
      "time"
    )

    func main() {
      key := os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"); if key == "" { log.Fatal("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY") }
      base := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL"), "/"); if base == "" { base = "https://api.dwchainless.com" }
      endpoint := "/v1/models"
      req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", base + endpoint, nil); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 120 * time.Second}
      response, err := client.Do(req); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; defer response.Body.Close()
      result, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      if response.StatusCode >= 400 { log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, result) }
      fmt.Println(string(result))
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Errors

| HTTP status | Meaning or vendor error type           | Action                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400         | Invalid request                        | Check required fields, JSON, model parameters, and context length.                                               |
| 401         | Authentication failed                  | Check that the key exists, is valid, and belongs to the correct service.                                         |
| 403 / 404   | Access denied / resource not found     | Check model permissions, resource IDs, and the URL.                                                              |
| 429         | Rate or quota limit                    | Distinguish rate limits from insufficient quota using the response body; retrying cannot fix insufficient quota. |
| 500 / 503   | Server error / temporarily unavailable | Retain the request identifier and use bounded backoff for transient failures.                                    |

Native OpenAI errors usually contain `error.message`, `error.type`, `error.param`, `error.code`; `param`, `code` may be `null`; do not assume these fields always exist or equal the HTTP status. The gateway may return authentication, routing, or quota errors before contacting the vendor; the status alone does not establish an upstream error. Also check gateway success=false application errors, which differ from successful HTTP transport.

## Official reference

* [OpenAI List models](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/models/methods/list)
* [OpenAI Retrieve model](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/models/methods/retrieve)
* [OpenAI error handling](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes)

# Other capabilities and integration references

This section collects endpoints not yet offered as general SimiRouter capabilities\: embeddings, files, fine-tuning, Realtime, moderation, and reranking. The difference from launched capabilities is not protocol difficulty but whether the gateway provides routing, authentication, and billing.

## Overview

Check the status first, then decide whether to write code. Being in this section does not mean the status is the same.

| Status                        | Meaning                                                                                               | What you can do now                                                             |
| ----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Explicitly unsupported        | The gateway does not provide this capability, and it will not become available by changing the domain | Only use vendor-direct references with a vendor key                             |
| Not currently supported       | Not open yet, though the protocol itself is stable                                                    | Validate against vendor-direct references; do not document it as a gateway call |
| Channel confirmation required | Availability depends on the account and channel configuration                                         | Confirm the model and route first, then decide whether to depend on it          |

## Core concepts

* **Direct references**\: the addresses and authentication in this section's examples belong to the vendor. Replacing `api.openai.com` with the gateway domain does not make a capability available; paths, field mappings, and permissions all require explicit channel support.
* **Key ownership**\: vendor keys and SimiRouter keys are not interchangeable. Direct examples must use the corresponding vendor key; a gateway key cannot be substituted.
* **Resource ownership**\: file IDs, task IDs, and session IDs are held by the project or organization that created them, and cannot be reused across vendors or projects.
* **Status and billing**\: asynchronous tasks return an ID first, then status is queried; successful creation is not successful execution, and cancelling a task does not reverse usage already incurred.

## Capabilities

| Category        | SimiRouter status                       | Protocol type                                                     | Reference                           |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- |
| Embeddings      | Not currently supported                 | Synchronous vector responses; separate batch jobs                 | [Embeddings](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/embeddings)          |
| File management | Unsupported                             | Upload, listing, metadata, download, and deletion                 | [Files](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/files)                    |
| Fine-tuning     | Unsupported                             | Create asynchronous training jobs, status, and events             | [Fine-tuning](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/fine-tuning)        |
| Realtime        | Dedicated channel confirmation required | Stateful WebRTC / WebSocket sessions                              | [Realtime](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/realtime)              |
| Moderation      | Model and route confirmation required   | Synchronous safety classification, not a chat-filtering guarantee | [Content moderation](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/moderations) |
| Reranking       | Model and route confirmation required   | Synchronous document-relevance ranking                            | [Reranking](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/rerank)               |

For music APIs, see [Music (unsupported)](/simidoc/en/apps/api/music). Realtime sessions, uploaded resources, and training jobs commonly involve extra permissions, storage, and cost. Define data retention and deletion policies before integration.

# Content moderation

## Endpoint overview

`POST https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations` synchronously evaluates safety categories for text or images using `Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY`. SimiRouter routing, models, and permissions require separate confirmation; examples below connect directly to OpenAI.

Moderation results are risk signals, not legal-compliance conclusions or a guarantee against missed cases. Image and text categories may differ. Inspect category\_applied\_input\_types; unsupported input in a category does not establish safety.

## Request parameters

| Field                   | Type                           | Required    | Description                                                                                 |
| ----------------------- | ------------------------------ | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                   | string                         | No          | For example, omni-moderation-latest; pinning a specific model reduces alias-update effects. |
| input                   | string / string\[] / object\[] | Yes         | Text or multimodal content items.                                                           |
| input\[].type           | string                         | Conditional | text or image\_url.                                                                         |
| input\[].text           | string                         | Conditional | Text to moderate.                                                                           |
| input\[].image\_url.url | string                         | Conditional | An image URL or data URL meeting model input requirements.                                  |

## Response

| Field                                    | Description                                                            |
| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id` / `model`                           | Request identifier and moderation model.                               |
| `results[].flagged`                      | Whether any category was flagged.                                      |
| `results[].categories`                   | Boolean results by category.                                           |
| `results[].category_scores`              | Category scores, not human judgment or fixed thresholds across models. |
| `results[].category_applied_input_types` | Input types applicable to each category.                               |

```json
{"id":"modr_example","model":"omni-moderation-latest","results":[{"flagged":false,"categories":{},"category_scores":{},"category_applied_input_types":{}}]}
```

The example omits category keys; actual responses include category details. Retain necessary risk evidence rather than keeping all raw user content indefinitely.

## Code examples

Python examples require `python3 -m pip install requests`; Node.js uses version 18+ with built-in fetch; Go uses standard libraries.

Set `OPENAI_API_KEY`.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import os
    import requests

    url = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations'
    headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY']}
    response = requests.request('POST', url, headers=headers, json={'model': 'omni-moderation-latest', 'input': '这是一段需要进行安全审核的示例文本。'}, timeout=180)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.text)
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">

    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/moderations";
      const headers = { "Authorization": "Bearer " + process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY };
      headers["Content-Type"] = "application/json";
      const body = JSON.stringify({
      "model": "omni-moderation-latest",
      "input": "这是一段需要进行安全审核的示例文本。"
    });
    ```
