## Errors

| HTTP status           | Meaning and action                                                                                         |
| --------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400 / 422             | Invalid fields, file format, or model parameters; correct before resubmitting.                             |
| 401                   | Missing, invalid, or expired API key.                                                                      |
| 403                   | No access to the project or model.                                                                         |
| 404                   | Model or route not found; check the address and project ownership.                                         |
| 413 / 415             | Upload too large or unsupported media type.                                                                |
| 429                   | Rate or quota limit; distinguish insufficient funds from retryable throttling.                             |
| 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 | Service or upstream failure. Keep the request ID, inspect the response body, then decide whether to retry. |

The error body’s `error.message`, `error.type`, `error.code` gives more specific reasons than HTTP status alone. Do not treat the error body as a moderation result.

## Official reference

[OpenAI Create moderation](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/moderations/methods/create).

# OpenAI Realtime API

## Endpoint overview

Realtime provides stateful, low-latency voice and text interaction. Clients continuously send events while the server produces audio, text, and tool-call events. It is separate from [TTS](/simidoc/en/apps/api/audio/speech), [file transcription](/simidoc/en/apps/api/audio/transcriptions) and [file translation](/simidoc/en/apps/api/audio/translations).

| Scenario                 | Official integration                                                   | Authentication                                                               |
| ------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Server-side WebSocket    | `wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=gpt-realtime-2.1`              | OpenAI API Key Bearer                                                        |
| Browser WebRTC           | `/v1/realtime/calls`; first create ephemeral credentials on the server | Short-lived client secret; never expose a standard key                       |
| Continuous transcription | Dedicated Realtime transcription session configuration                 | Use the corresponding intent/config; not equivalent to ordinary conversation |

Examples connect directly to OpenAI. SimiRouter WebSocket upgrades, event passthrough, and model permissions require a dedicated channel check. An ordinary HTTP GET response does not establish a successful realtime connection. The GA protocol does not use the old `OpenAI-Beta: realtime=v1`.

## Request parameters

| Field                        | Type           | Required    | Description                                                                                            |
| ---------------------------- | -------------- | ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| model (connection query)     | string         | Conditional | Model for creating a session, such as gpt-realtime-2.1; use call\_id to join an existing call.         |
| call\_id (connection query)  | string         | Conditional | Join an established call; do not confuse this with a model for creating a new session.                 |
| session.type                 | string         | Yes         | Use realtime for session updates; transcription requires separate configuration.                       |
| session.instructions         | string         | No          | System-level style and behavior instructions.                                                          |
| session.output\_modalities   | string\[]      | No          | text or audio, according to current Realtime session configuration.                                    |
| session.audio                | object         | No          | Input/output audio formats, voice, and voice-activity detection; must match capture/playback encoding. |
| session.tools / tool\_choice | array / string | No          | Tool definitions and selection; validate arguments in application logic.                               |
| event\_id                    | string         | No          | A client tracking ID for correlating error events.                                                     |

### Common client events

| Event                       | Purpose                                                                             |
| --------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session.update`            | Update session configuration; read session.updated for the actual settings.         |
| `conversation.item.create`  | Add text or other permitted content items to the session.                           |
| `input_audio_buffer.append` | Base64 audio chunks encoded to match session.audio.input.format.                    |
| `input_audio_buffer.commit` | Commit the buffer; committing alone does not automatically create a reply.          |
| `input_audio_buffer.clear`  | Discard uncommitted input.                                                          |
| `response.create`           | Request response generation.                                                        |
| `response.cancel`           | Cancel a response in progress; the playback client must also handle buffered audio. |

For a continuous microphone, stream chunks at the actual sample rate. VAD determines automatic commits/generation. Interruptions also require clearing playback buffers or truncating conversation items according to the official protocol; stopping the speaker alone is insufficient.

## Response

| Server events                            | Key fields / meaning                                                   |
| ---------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `session.created` / `session.updated`    | Session identifier and actual configuration.                           |
| `response.output_text.delta`             | Incremental delta text.                                                |
| `response.output_audio.delta`            | delta is Base64 audio that must be decoded.                            |
| `response.output_audio_transcript.delta` | Text corresponding to speech; not a substitute for the audio.          |
| `response.done`                          | response.status and usage; only completed indicates normal completion. |
| `error`                                  | error.type, code, message, event\_id, and others.                      |

Realtime uses bidirectional WebSocket events, not `data:` SSE. A disconnect or partial audio is not complete success, and text length cannot determine final charges.

## Code examples

Set the official `OPENAI_API_KEY`. Python requires `python3 -m pip install websockets`; Node.js requires `npm install ws`; Go requires `go get github.com/gorilla/websocket`. The following sends one turn of **text** to verify the complete event flow, not microphone/speaker integration, with a 60-second maximum wait.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import asyncio
    import json
    import os
    from websockets.asyncio.client import connect

    async def main():
        url = "wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=gpt-realtime-2.1"
        async with connect(url, additional_headers={"Authorization":"Bearer " + os.environ["OPENAI_API_KEY"]}, open_timeout=20) as ws:
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"type":"session.update","session":{"type":"realtime","output_modalities":["text"]}}))
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"type":"conversation.item.create","item":{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[{"type":"input_text","text":"请用一句话介绍你自己。"}]}}))
            await ws.send(json.dumps({"type":"response.create"}))
            async for raw in ws:
                event = json.loads(raw)
                if event["type"] == "error":
                    raise RuntimeError(event["error"])
                if event["type"] == "response.output_text.delta":
                    print(event["delta"], end="", flush=True)
                if event["type"] == "response.done":
                    if event["response"]["status"] != "completed":
                        raise RuntimeError(event["response"])
                    print()
                    return
            raise RuntimeError("连接在 response.done 前关闭")
    asyncio.run(asyncio.wait_for(main(), 60))
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    const WebSocket = require("ws");
    const ws = new WebSocket("wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=gpt-realtime-2.1", {
      headers:{Authorization:"Bearer " + process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY}
    });
    let completed = false;
    const timer = setTimeout(() => { console.error("会话超时"); process.exitCode=1; ws.terminate(); }, 60000);
    ws.on("open", () => {
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:"session.update",session:{type:"realtime",output_modalities:["text"]}}));
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:"conversation.item.create",item:{type:"message",role:"user",content:[{type:"input_text",text:"请用一句话介绍你自己。"}]}}));
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:"response.create"}));
    });
    ws.on("message", raw => {
      try {
        const event = JSON.parse(raw.toString());
        if(event.type === "error") throw new Error(JSON.stringify(event.error));
        if(event.type === "response.output_text.delta") process.stdout.write(event.delta);
        if(event.type === "response.done") {
          if(event.response.status !== "completed") throw new Error(JSON.stringify(event.response));
          completed = true; console.log(); ws.close();
        }
      } catch(error) { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; ws.close(); }
    });
    ws.on("error", error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; });
    ws.on("close", () => { clearTimeout(timer); if(!completed) {console.error("连接未正常完成"); process.exitCode=1;} });
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="curl">
    ```text
    cURL 单条 HTTP 命令不能完成双向实时语音会话。
    不要把 GET /v1/realtime 或 HTTP 101 握手当成完整调用。
    请使用本页 WebSocket 示例，浏览器使用官方 WebRTC 流程。
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Go">
    ```go
    package main
    import (
      "encoding/json"
      "fmt"
      "net/http"
      "os"
      "time"
      "github.com/gorilla/websocket"
    )
    func check(err error) {if err!=nil {panic(err)}}
    func main() {
      header:=http.Header{"Authorization":[]string{"Bearer "+os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY")}}
      dialer:=websocket.Dialer{HandshakeTimeout:20*time.Second}
      ws,_,err:=dialer.Dial("wss://api.openai.com/v1/realtime?model=gpt-realtime-2.1",header);check(err);defer ws.Close()
      check(ws.SetReadDeadline(time.Now().Add(60*time.Second)))
      check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]any{"type":"session.update","session":map[string]any{"type":"realtime","output_modalities":[]string{"text"}}}))
      check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]any{"type":"conversation.item.create","item":map[string]any{"type":"message","role":"user","content":[]any{map[string]any{"type":"input_text","text":"请用一句话介绍你自己。"}}}}))
      check(ws.WriteJSON(map[string]string{"type":"response.create"}))
      for {
        _,raw,err:=ws.ReadMessage();check(err)
        var event struct {Type string `json:"type"`;Delta string `json:"delta"`;Error json.RawMessage `json:"error"`;Response struct{Status string `json:"status"`} `json:"response"`}
        check(json.Unmarshal(raw,&event))
        switch event.Type {
        case "error":panic(string(event.Error))
        case "response.output_text.delta":fmt.Print(event.Delta)
        case "response.done":if event.Response.Status!="completed" {panic(event.Response.Status)};fmt.Println();return
        }
      }
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Errors

During the handshake, HTTP 400/401/403/404/429 indicate parameter, authentication, permission, model, or quota issues. Once connected, handle error events, failure status in response.done, and WebSocket close codes/reasons. Report abnormal disconnects or timeouts as incomplete. Reestablish state after reconnecting; do not blindly replay tools or side-effecting operations already triggered.

## Official reference

[Realtime connect](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/python/resources/realtime/methods/connect), [Client events](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/realtime/client-events), [Server events](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/realtime/server-events), [Realtime guide](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/realtime).

# Document reranking

## Endpoint overview

Reranking compares a query with candidate documents and returns indices and relevance scores in ranked order. It does not generate answers or embedding vectors. Availability of SimiRouter’s `/v1/rerank` requires channel confirmation; the following demonstrates only **official Cohere access** `POST https://api.cohere.com/v2/rerank` and `Authorization: Bearer $COHERE_API_KEY`.

## Request parameters

| Field                 | Type      | Required | Description                                                                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | --------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                 | string    | Yes      | For example, rerank-v5.0-pro; select a model enabled for your account.                                                                             |
| query                 | string    | Yes      | The search query.                                                                                                                                  |
| documents             | string\[] | Yes      | Candidate text strings; the official recommendation is no more than 1,000 per request. Structured content can first be serialized as YAML strings. |
| top\_n                | integer   | No       | At least 1; omit to return all results.                                                                                                            |
| max\_tokens\_per\_doc | integer   | No       | Default 4,096; long documents are truncated.                                                                                                       |
| relevant\_spans       | object    | No       | v5 and newer models can return relevant text spans.                                                                                                |
| priority              | integer   | No       | 0–999; default 0. Lower numbers have higher priority.                                                                                              |

Cohere v2 documents is an array of strings; do not mix in undefined objects. `return_documents` belongs to other protocol versions and is not sent in this example.

## Response

`results[]` is sorted by relevance\: `index` points to the original document index, and `relevance_score` is the relevance score. When enabled and supported, responses include `relevant_spans[]`. Scores are not accuracy measures or uniform probabilities comparable across models. `meta.billed_units` records usage.

```json
{"results":[{"index":1,"relevance_score":0.95},{"index":0,"relevance_score":0.12}],"id":"request_example","meta":{"api_version":{"version":"2"}}}
```

## Code examples

Python examples require `python3 -m pip install requests`; Node.js uses version 18+ with built-in fetch; Go uses standard libraries.

Set the official Cohere `COHERE_API_KEY`. Examples use a positive top\_n and nonempty queries and documents.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>

    ```go
    }`)
      req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.cohere.com/v2/rerank", body); check(err)
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + os.Getenv("COHERE_API_KEY"))
      req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 180 * time.Second}
      res, err := client.Do(req); check(err)
      defer res.Body.Close()
      data, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body); check(err)
      if res.StatusCode < 200 || res.StatusCode >= 300 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", res.StatusCode, data)) }
      fmt.Println(string(data))
    }
    ```
  </Tab>
</Tabs>

## Errors

| HTTP status           | Description                                                                         |
| --------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400 / 422             | Invalid parameters or model-incompatible input.                                     |
| 401 / 498             | Authentication failed or token invalid.                                             |
| 403 / 404             | Insufficient permissions or resource not found.                                     |
| 429                   | Rate limit; check quota and use bounded backoff.                                    |
| 499                   | The client closed the request.                                                      |
| 500 / 501 / 503 / 504 | Internal service error, unimplemented operation, or timeout; retain the request ID. |

## Official reference

[Cohere Rerank v2](https\://docs.cohere.com/reference/rerank).

# File content understanding

## Endpoint overview

`POST /v1/responses` input\_file items let supported models process files. File understanding is not file storage and does not guarantee complete or accurate OCR.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. Direct OpenAI access uses `https://api.openai.com` and Bearer authentication, but requires an OpenAI key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

The gateway’s `/v1/files` upload, retrieval, and deletion endpoints are unimplemented. This page inlines Base64 PDFs without Files API dependencies. Direct official access can upload a file and reference file\_id, but an official file\_id is not automatically gateway-accessible.

## Request parameters

| Field                    | Type    | Required    | Description                                                                                                                                                                             |
| ------------------------ | ------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                    | string  | Yes         | A model ID supporting PDF input and the required vision capabilities.                                                                                                                   |
| input\[].role            | string  | Yes         | user here.                                                                                                                                                                              |
| input\[].content\[].type | string  | Yes         | Use input\_text for questions and input\_file for files.                                                                                                                                |
| input\_text.text         | string  | Yes         | The file task, such as summarizing, extracting fields, or answering questions.                                                                                                          |
| input\_file.filename     | string  | Conditional | The inline file’s name, retaining its real extension.                                                                                                                                   |
| input\_file.file\_data   | string  | Conditional | The PDF’s Base64 data; this page’s code uses a data\:application/pdf;base64,... prefix. The official spec only requires Base64, so drop the data\:... prefix if the channel rejects it. |
| input\_file.file\_id     | string  | Conditional | A file ID from an official upload; depends on the corresponding service’s Files support.                                                                                                |
| input\_file.file\_url    | string  | Conditional | A file URL readable by the vendor; select one source rather than combining with inline data.                                                                                            |
| max\_output\_tokens      | integer | No          | The model output limit.                                                                                                                                                                 |
| stream                   | boolean | No          | true uses Responses SSE.                                                                                                                                                                |

Do not send a local path as file\_url or populate file\_data, file\_id, and file\_url together. Request size must satisfy both gateway and official file-input limits. Base64 is larger than the source, and PDF page images increase model input tokens.

### Request structure

BASE64\_PDF\_BYTES represents the original PDF’s Base64; the four language examples populate it after reading PDF\_PATH.

```json
{
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "input": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "input_text",
          "text": "请总结PDF的主要内容，并标注无法可靠读取的部分。"
        },
        {
          "type": "input_file",
          "filename": "document.pdf",
          "file_data": "data:application/pdf;base64,BASE64_PDF_BYTES"
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "max_output_tokens": 1024,
  "stream": false
}
```

## Response

File input returns a standard Responses object, not a separate file-task ID.

| Field                                                | Type             | Description                                                                                                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id / object                                          | string           | Response ID; object=response.                                                                                                         |
| created\_at / model                                  | integer / string | Creation time in Unix seconds and model.                                                                                              |
| status                                               | string           | completed, incomplete, failed, queued, in\_progress, or cancelled; these states can appear in both streamed and background responses. |
| output\[]                                            | array            | Typed output items may mix message, reasoning, function\_call, web\_search\_call, and more; do not hard-code output\[0].              |
| output\[].type / id / status                         | string           | Output item type, ID, and status, where applicable.                                                                                   |
| output\[].role                                       | string           | Message output usually uses assistant.                                                                                                |
| output\[].content\[]                                 | array            | Message content items\: type=output\_text for text, type=refusal for refusals.                                                        |
| output\[].content\[].text / annotations              | string / array   | Response text and annotations such as citations.                                                                                      |
| output\[].call\_id / name / arguments                | string           | The function\_call correlation ID, name, and JSON-string arguments.                                                                   |
| error                                                | object / null    | Failure information; usually null on normal completion.                                                                               |
| incomplete\_details                                  | object / null    | The incomplete reason, such as max\_output\_tokens; do not treat it as complete success.                                              |
| usage.input\_tokens / output\_tokens / total\_tokens | integer          | Input, output, and total tokens.                                                                                                      |
| usage.\*\_tokens\_details                            | object           | Optional usage details such as caching and reasoning.                                                                                 |

```json
{
  "id": "resp_file_example",
  "object": "response",
  "status": "completed",
  "error": null,
  "incomplete_details": null,
  "output": [
    {
      "id": "msg_file_example",
      "type": "message",
      "role": "assistant",
      "status": "completed",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "output_text",
          "text": "这份文档主要讨论项目背景、实施步骤和风险。部分扫描页较模糊，无法确认细小文字。",
          "annotations": []
        }
      ]
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "input_tokens": 1800,
    "output_tokens": 75,
    "total_tokens": 1875
  }
}
```

Chat Completions also supports `type=file` and nested file.filename/file\_data for PDFs, but differs from Responses input\_file. Base64 for arbitrary TXT files, spreadsheets, or archives is not universally supported. Applications can decode text and send it as text; verify vendor and model support for other formats first.

## Code examples

Set `SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`, `SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL`; `SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL` overrides the default gateway root; do not append `/v1`. `PDF_PATH` points to an existing local file. Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use only standard libraries; the curl example uses Python 3 to encode JSON safely.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
    import base64
    from pathlib import Path
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY")
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL")
    base = os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL", "https://api.dwchainless.com").rstrip("/")
    body = json.loads(r'''{
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "input": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": [
            {
              "type": "input_text",
              "text": "请总结PDF的主要内容，并标注无法可靠读取的部分。"
            },
            {
              "type": "input_file",
              "filename": "document.pdf",
              "file_data": "data:application/pdf;base64,BASE64_PDF_BYTES"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "max_output_tokens": 1024,
      "stream": false
    }''')
    body["model"] = os.environ["SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL"]
    p = Path(os.environ["PDF_PATH"])
    if not p.is_file(): raise FileNotFoundError(p)
    mime = {'.pdf': 'application/pdf'}.get(p.suffix.lower())
    if not mime: raise ValueError("不支持的文件扩展名")
    data = p.read_bytes()
    if not data: raise ValueError("输入文件为空")
    encoded = base64.b64encode(data).decode("ascii")
    body["input"][0]["content"][1].update({"filename": p.name, "file_data": "data:" + mime + ";base64," + encoded})
    path = '/v1/responses'
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        print(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode()}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const fs = require("node:fs");
      const path = require("node:path");
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY");
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL");
      const base = (process.env.SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL || "https://api.dwchainless.com").replace(/\/$/, "");
      const body = {
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "input": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": [
            {
              "type": "input_text",
              "text": "请总结PDF的主要内容，并标注无法可靠读取的部分。"
            },
            {
              "type": "input_file",
              "filename": "document.pdf",
              "file_data": "data:application/pdf;base64,BASE64_PDF_BYTES"
            }
          ]
        }
      ],
      "max_output_tokens": 1024,
      "stream": false
    };
      body.model = process.env.SIMIROUTER_FILE_MODEL;
      const filename = process.env.PDF_PATH;
      if (!filename) throw new Error("请设置 PDF_PATH");
      const mime = {".pdf": "application/pdf"}[path.extname(filename).toLowerCase()];
      if (!mime) throw new Error("不支持的文件扩展名");
      const data = fs.readFileSync(filename);
      if (!data.length) throw new Error("输入文件为空");
      const encoded = data.toString("base64");
      Object.assign(body.input[0].content[1], { filename: path.basename(filename), file_data: `data:${mime};base64,${encoded}` });
      const endpoint = "/v1/responses";
      const response = await fetch(base + endpoint, { method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000) });
      const result = await response.text();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${result}`);
      console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(result), null, 2));
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```

    ```go
      data, err := os.ReadFile(filename); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; if len(data) == 0 { log.Fatal("输入文件为空") }
      encoded := base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(data)
      item := body["input"].([]any)[0].(map[string]any)["content"].([]any)[1].(map[string]any); item["filename"] = filepath.Base(filename); item["file_data"] = "data:" + mime + ";base64," + encoded
      endpoint := "/v1/responses"
      payload, err := json.Marshal(body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", base + endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload)); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 120 * time.Second}
      response, err := client.Do(req); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; defer response.Body.Close()
      result, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      if response.StatusCode >= 400 { log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, result) }
      fmt.Println(string(result))
    }
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status | Meaning or vendor error type           | Action                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400         | Invalid request                        | Check required fields, JSON, model parameters, and context length.                                               |
| 401         | Authentication failed                  | Check that the key exists, is valid, and belongs to the correct service.                                         |
| 403 / 404   | Access denied / resource not found     | Check model permissions, resource IDs, and the URL.                                                              |
| 429         | Rate or quota limit                    | Distinguish rate limits from insufficient quota using the response body; retrying cannot fix insufficient quota. |
| 500 / 503   | Server error / temporarily unavailable | Retain the request identifier and use bounded backoff for transient failures.                                    |

Native OpenAI errors usually contain `error.message`, `error.type`, `error.param`, `error.code`; `param`, `code` may be `null`; do not assume these fields always exist or equal the HTTP status. The gateway may return authentication, routing, or quota errors before contacting the vendor; the status alone does not establish an upstream error. Correct damaged, password-protected, oversized, or unsupported files; do not repeatedly retry an invalid file or fabricate successful recognition.

# Files and content understanding

File workflows have two layers\: upload APIs manage resources, while model-input APIs read file content and generate answers. Attaching a file to a generation request does not store it as a reusable resource.

## Overview

| What you want to do                  | Input method                        | Where the file goes      | Upload first?               |
| ------------------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------ | --------------------------- |
| Have the model read a PDF            | Inline Base64 or a reachable URL    | Only inside this request | No                          |
| Reuse a file across several requests | file\_id or a vendor file reference | Vendor file resource     | Yes (official Files API)    |
| Preprocess large or numerous files   | Upload, then wait for processing    | Vendor file resource     | Yes, and it has a lifecycle |

## Core concepts

* **Inline input**\: the file is encoded into the request body and sent with the message. It ends with the request, there is no file\_id, and there is no later delete step.
* **File resource**\: upload first to obtain an id, then reference it in multiple requests. The resource has an owner, an expiry, and a quota, and must be deleted explicitly.
* **Lifecycle**\: a finished upload is neither a finished text extraction nor a model that already understands the file; poll until it is processable before reasoning over it.
* **Size and format**\: limits are set separately for file size, page count, and duration; compressing an image does not convert its file type, and scanned PDFs still need OCR capability.
* **Data retention**\: vendors differ on how they retain file content and recognition results; for sensitive material, confirm authorization and deletion methods first.

## Requests and capabilities

| Purpose                                            | Request                                       | Boundary                                                                               |
| -------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [PDF content understanding](/simidoc/en/apps/api/upload/file-recognition)    | POST /v1/responses + input\_file              | Inline Base64; no Files API required.                                                  |
| Chat PDF input                                     | POST /v1/chat/completions + type=file         | Uses Chat’s file object, not the Responses structure.                                  |
| [Files API](/simidoc/en/apps/api/pending/files)                      | /v1/files                                     | Not implemented in the gateway; official native uploads do not imply platform support. |
| [Gemini media understanding](/simidoc/en/apps/api/chat/gemini-media) | POST /v1beta/models/\{model}\:generateContent | inlineData or applicable fileData.                                                     |

## Request mode

Inline understanding can return synchronous JSON or streamed text events; both are one model request. Some official upload or preprocessing workflows wait for resources to become usable. This is a resource lifecycle, not automatic background model execution. Multiple files can share one supported request or use parallel requests, with different context, cost, and total-size limits.

Before uploading sensitive files, confirm authorization and provider data policies. Select relevant pages or excerpts from large documents rather than increasing input without limit. Preserve uncertainty in recognition results; manually verify important amounts, identifiers, and legal or medical conclusions.

## Simulated call

Inline understanding completes in one request, with the file carried as Base64 inside `input_file`\:

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "input": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": [
        { "type": "input_text", "text": "总结这份合同的付款条款。" },
        { "type": "input_file", "filename": "contract.pdf", "file_data": "data:application/pdf;base64,JVBERi0xLjQK..." }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

The response is an ordinary model message, and the result sits in `output_text`\:

```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "output": [
    {
      "type": "message",
      "content": [
        { "type": "output_text", "text": "（示意）合同约定分三期付款……" }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Nothing is uploaded and no reusable file\_id appears; asking about the same file again means resubmitting the Base64 or switching to official file resources.

## Official reference

* [OpenAI file input](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/file-inputs)
* [OpenAI Files API](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/files/methods/create)
* [Google file input](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/file-input-methods)

# Function tool calling

## Endpoint overview

`POST /v1/chat/completions` uses tools to tell the model which functions are available. The model generates only function names and arguments. The application validates, authorizes, and executes them, then returns results in tool messages and requests a final answer. Function calling itself does not access databases, transfer funds, or send notifications for the application.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. Direct OpenAI access uses `https://api.openai.com` and Bearer authentication, but requires an OpenAI key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

## Request parameters

| Field                         | Type            | Required    | Description                                                                                                                |
| ----------------------------- | --------------- | ----------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model / messages              | string / array  | Yes         | Model and conversation; the model must support function tools.                                                             |
| tools\[].type                 | string          | Yes         | function here.                                                                                                             |
| tools\[].function.name        | string          | Yes         | The function name, dispatched through an application allowlist.                                                            |
| tools\[].function.description | string          | No          | Describe its purpose, input boundaries, and side effects.                                                                  |
| tools\[].function.parameters  | object          | Yes         | JSON Schema for function arguments.                                                                                        |
| tools\[].function.strict      | boolean         | No          | true requires strict adherence to the supported Schema subset.                                                             |
| tool\_choice                  | string / object | No          | auto lets the model choose; none disables tools; required requires at least one; a specific function can also be selected. |
| parallel\_tool\_calls         | boolean         | No          | Allow multiple calls in one turn; false limits it to at most one.                                                          |
| messages\[].tool\_call\_id    | string          | Conditional | When returning a tool message, match the assistant tool\_calls id.                                                         |
| messages\[].content           | string          | Conditional | The execution result in the tool message; JSON-serialized text is recommended.                                             |

With strict=true, each object requires additionalProperties=false and all properties in required. Logically optional fields can permit null. Unsupported Schemas cause request errors.

### First request

```json
{
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "请计算17乘以23。"
    }
  ],
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "multiply_numbers",
        "description": "将两个整数相乘。",
        "strict": true,
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "a": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "b": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "a",
            "b"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "auto",
  "parallel_tool_calls": false,
  "stream": false
}
```

## Response

| Field                                | Type          | Description                                                                                    |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| choices\[].message.tool\_calls\[].id | string        | The tool-call ID used as tool\_call\_id afterward.                                             |
| tool\_calls\[].type                  | string        | function.                                                                                      |
| tool\_calls\[].function.name         | string        | The requested function name; must match the application allowlist.                             |
| tool\_calls\[].function.arguments    | string        | JSON text, not a parsed object; parse, then validate types and values.                         |
| choices\[].message.content           | string / null | May be null during function calling.                                                           |
| choices\[].finish\_reason            | string        | tool\_calls means tools need execution; stop usually indicates a final natural-language reply. |
| usage                                | object        | Each model request incurs its own token usage.                                                 |

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl_tool_example",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": null,
        "tool_calls": [
          {
            "id": "call_example",
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
              "name": "multiply_numbers",
              "arguments": "{\"a\":17,\"b\":23}"
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
    }
  ]
}
```

### Execute and return results

Validate name=multiply\_numbers and that a and b are integers in the allowed range; the result is 391. The following is the complete second request. Replace call\_example with the actual ID from the first response; a static ID cannot be reused for arbitrary requests.

```json
{
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "请计算17乘以23。"
    },
    {
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": null,
      "tool_calls": [
        {
          "id": "call_example",
          "type": "function",
          "function": {
            "name": "multiply_numbers",
            "arguments": "{\"a\":17,\"b\":23}"
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "role": "tool",
      "tool_call_id": "call_example",
      "content": "391"
    }
  ],
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "multiply_numbers",
        "description": "将两个整数相乘。",
        "strict": true,
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": {
            "a": {
              "type": "integer"
            },
            "b": {
              "type": "integer"
            }
          },
          "required": [
            "a",
            "b"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false
        }
      }
    }
  ],
  "tool_choice": "none",
  "stream": false
}
```

Return a result for every tool\_call; do not omit results or mix IDs from other conversations. Execute concurrently only authorized, independent tools. Sending, charging, and similar side effects need separate idempotency controls; a repeated model request must not cause duplicate execution.

### Responses format differences

Responses defines type, name, description, parameters, and strict directly in tools\[], without a function wrapper. It returns type=function\_call output items; return results using `{"type":"function_call_output","call_id":"...","output":"391"}`. Do not mix Chat tool\_call\_id with Responses call\_id.

## Code examples

The four language examples automatically execute one side-effect-free local multiplication and return it, with at most two model requests and no infinite loop. Set `SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`, `SIMIROUTER_MODEL`; `SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL` overrides the default gateway root; do not append `/v1`. Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use only standard libraries. The curl example uses Python 3 to encode JSON safely.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY")
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_MODEL"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL")
    base = os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL", "https://api.dwchainless.com").rstrip("/")
    body = json.loads(r'''{
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "messages": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": "请计算17乘以23。"
        }
      ],
      "tools": [
        {
          "type": "function",
          "function": {
            "name": "multiply_numbers",
            "description": "将两个整数相乘。",
            "strict": true,
            "parameters": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "a": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "b": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "a",
                "b"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "tool_choice": "auto",
      "parallel_tool_calls": false,
      "stream": false
    }''')
    body["model"] = os.environ["SIMIROUTER_MODEL"]
    path = '/v1/chat/completions'
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        print(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode()}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    assistant = result["choices"][0]["message"]
    body["messages"].append(assistant)
    for call in assistant.get("tool_calls", []):
        if call.get("type") != "function" or call["function"]["name"] != "multiply_numbers":
            raise ValueError("未知函数")
        args = json.loads(call["function"]["arguments"])
        if set(args) != {"a", "b"} or any(type(args[k]) is not int or abs(args[k]) > 1000000 for k in ("a", "b")):
            raise ValueError("参数须为绝对值不超过1000000的两个整数")
        body["messages"].append({"role": "tool", "tool_call_id": call["id"], "content": str(args["a"] * args["b"])})
    if assistant.get("tool_calls"):
        body["tool_choice"] = "none"
        request.data = json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8")
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
                result = json.load(response)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
            print(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode()}", file=sys.stderr)
            raise SystemExit(1)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    ```

    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY");
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_MODEL) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL");
      const base = (process.env.SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL || "https://api.dwchainless.com").replace(/\/$/, "");
      const body = {
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "messages": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": "请计算17乘以23。"
        }
      ],
      "tools": [
        {
          "type": "function",
          "function": {
            "name": "multiply_numbers",
            "description": "将两个整数相乘。",
            "strict": true,
            "parameters": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "a": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "b": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "a",
                "b"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "tool_choice": "auto",
      "parallel_tool_calls": false,
      "stream": false
    };
      body.model = process.env.SIMIROUTER_MODEL;
      const endpoint = "/v1/chat/completions";
      const response = await fetch(base + endpoint, { method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000) });
      const result = await response.text();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${result}`);
      let parsed = JSON.parse(result);
      const assistant = parsed.choices[0].message;
      body.messages.push(assistant);
      for (const call of assistant.tool_calls || []) {
        if (call.type !== "function" || call.function.name !== "multiply_numbers") throw new Error("未知函数");
        const args = JSON.parse(call.function.arguments);
        if (Object.keys(args).sort().join(",") !== "a,b" || ![args.a, args.b].every(x => Number.isSafeInteger(x) && Math.abs(x) <= 1000000)) throw new Error("函数参数超出范围");
        body.messages.push({ role: "tool", tool_call_id: call.id, content: String(args.a * args.b) });
      }
      if (assistant.tool_calls?.length) {
        body.tool_choice = "none";
        const final = await fetch(base + endpoint, { method: "POST", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" }, body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000) });
        const text = await final.text();
        if (!final.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${final.status}: ${text}`);
        parsed = JSON.parse(text);
      }
      console.log(JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2));
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```

    ```go
    package main

    import (
      "math"
      "bytes"
      "fmt"
      "io"
      "log"
      "net/http"
      "os"
      "strings"
      "time"
      "encoding/json"
    )

    func main() {
      key := os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"); if key == "" { log.Fatal("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY") }
      model := os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_MODEL"); if model == "" { log.Fatal("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL") }
      base := strings.TrimRight(os.Getenv("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL"), "/"); if base == "" { base = "https://api.dwchainless.com" }
      var body map[string]any
      if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(`{
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "messages": [
        {
          "role": "user",
          "content": "请计算17乘以23。"
        }
      ],
      "tools": [
        {
          "type": "function",
          "function": {
            "name": "multiply_numbers",
            "description": "将两个整数相乘。",
            "strict": true,
            "parameters": {
              "type": "object",
              "properties": {
                "a": {
                  "type": "integer"
                },
                "b": {
                  "type": "integer"
                }
              },
              "required": [
                "a",
                "b"
              ],
              "additionalProperties": false
            }
          }
        }
      ],
      "tool_choice": "auto",
      "parallel_tool_calls": false,
      "stream": false
    }`), &body); err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      body["model"] = model
      endpoint := "/v1/chat/completions"
      payload, err := json.Marshal(body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", base + endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload)); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 120 * time.Second}
      response, err := client.Do(req); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; defer response.Body.Close()
      result, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      if response.StatusCode >= 400 { log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, result) }
      var parsed struct { Choices []struct { Message map[string]any `json:"message"` } `json:"choices"` }
      if err := json.Unmarshal(result, &parsed); err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
      if len(parsed.Choices) == 0 { log.Fatal("响应没有候选消息") }
      assistant := parsed.Choices[0].Message
      messages := body["messages"].([]any)
      messages = append(messages, assistant)
      calls, _ := assistant["tool_calls"].([]any)
      for _, raw := range calls {
        call, ok := raw.(map[string]any); if !ok { log.Fatal("无效调用") }
        function, ok := call["function"].(map[string]any); if !ok || call["type"] != "function" || function["name"] != "multiply_numbers" { log.Fatal("未知函数") }
        arguments, ok := function["arguments"].(string); if !ok { log.Fatal("参数不是JSON文本") }
        var args map[string]any; if err := json.Unmarshal([]byte(arguments), &args); err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
        a, aOK := args["a"].(float64); b, bOK := args["b"].(float64)
        if len(args) != 2 || !aOK || !bOK || math.Trunc(a) != a || math.Trunc(b) != b || math.Abs(a) > 1000000 || math.Abs(b) > 1000000 { log.Fatal("函数参数超出范围") }
        id, ok := call["id"].(string); if !ok || id == "" { log.Fatal("缺少调用ID") }
        messages = append(messages, map[string]any{"role":"tool", "tool_call_id":id, "content":fmt.Sprintf("%.0f", a*b)})
      }
      if len(calls) > 0 {
        body["messages"] = messages; body["tool_choice"] = "none"
        payload, err = json.Marshal(body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
        req, err = http.NewRequest("POST", base + endpoint, bytes.NewReader(payload)); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
        req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
        final, err := client.Do(req); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }; defer final.Body.Close()
        result, err = io.ReadAll(final.Body); if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }
        if final.StatusCode >= 400 { log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", final.StatusCode, result) }
      }
      fmt.Println(string(result))
    }
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status | Meaning or vendor error type           | Action                                                                                                           |
| ----------- | -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400         | Invalid request                        | Check required fields, JSON, model parameters, and context length.                                               |
| 401         | Authentication failed                  | Check that the key exists, is valid, and belongs to the correct service.                                         |
| 403 / 404   | Access denied / resource not found     | Check model permissions, resource IDs, and the URL.                                                              |
| 429         | Rate or quota limit                    | Distinguish rate limits from insufficient quota using the response body; retrying cannot fix insufficient quota. |
| 500 / 503   | Server error / temporarily unavailable | Retain the request identifier and use bounded backoff for transient failures.                                    |

Native OpenAI errors usually contain `error.message`, `error.type`, `error.param`, `error.code`; `param`, `code` may be `null`; do not assume these fields always exist or equal the HTTP status. The gateway may return authentication, routing, or quota errors before contacting the vendor; the status alone does not establish an upstream error. Invalid arguments JSON, unknown functions, or execution failures are application errors; never fabricate tool success. A successful HTTP response may only request a tool rather than complete the user’s task.

* [OpenAI function calling](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/function-calling)
* [OpenAI Chat Completions](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/chat/subresources/completions/methods/create)
* [OpenAI Responses](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/responses/methods/create)
* [OpenAI error handling](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/error-codes)

# Tool calling

Tools connect models with data, computation, and external services. Models select tools and construct arguments; the application or vendor service executes them. Tool results and final natural-language answers are separate stages.

## Overview

| Capability           | Who executes | What you see                                  | Typical use                                             |
| -------------------- | ------------ | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- |
| Client-side function | Your program | The call intent plus the result you send back | Query a database, call an internal API, decrement stock |
| Server-side search   | The vendor   | The final answer with cited sources           | Look up recent information, verify facts                |

## Core concepts

* **Tool definition**\: a name, a description of purpose, and a JSON Schema for the parameters. The clearer the description, the lower the chance the model picks the wrong tool or invents arguments.
* **Call intent**\: the model does not execute code; it returns `tool_calls`, where `arguments` is a JSON string. It may arrive in fragments during streaming, so collect it fully before parsing.
* **Execution and return**\: your program validates the arguments, runs the function, and sends the result back as a message with `role` set to `tool` and the same `tool_call_id`; only then does the model continue.
* **Server-side tool**\: retrieval happens on the vendor side. You only receive the answer and citations, cannot control the intermediate steps, and cannot apply client-side function usage to it.

## Simulated call

The field shapes for one client-side function call, the model response, and the returned result are as follows (content is illustrative)\:

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "上海今天多少度？" }],
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "function",
      "function": {
        "name": "get_weather",
        "description": "查询指定城市的实时天气",
        "parameters": {
          "type": "object",
          "properties": { "city": { "type": "string" } },
          "required": ["city"]
        }
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

The model returns a call intent rather than a temperature\:

```json
{
  "choices": [
    {
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": null,
        "tool_calls": [
          {
            "id": "call_abc",
            "type": "function",
            "function": {
              "name": "get_weather",
              "arguments": "{\"city\":\"上海\"}"
            }
          }
        ]
      },
      "finish_reason": "tool_calls"
    }
  ]
}
```

After executing the function, append the result as a new message and request again\:

```json
{
  "role": "tool",
  "tool_call_id": "call_abc",
  "content": "{\"temp_c\": 18}"
}
```

The third response is the natural-language answer shown to the user. Throughout the chain, the model never actually reached a weather service; your program is the executor.

### Server-side search

A server-side tool takes only one round trip\: you declare the tool, the vendor performs the retrieval, and a single response contains both the retrieval record and the final answer.

```json
{
  "model": "gpt-5.5",
  "input": "查找 OpenAI 官方文档中关于 Responses API 的说明，并提供来源链接。",
  "tools": [{ "type": "web_search" }],
  "stream": false
}
```

The returned `output[]` usually shows the retrieval action first, then the final message with citations\:

```json
{
  "status": "completed",
  "output": [
    {
      "type": "web_search_call",
      "status": "completed",
      "action": { "type": "search", "query": "site:developers.openai.com Responses API" }
    },
    {
      "type": "message",
      "role": "assistant",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "output_text",
          "text": "Responses API 用于生成模型响应……",
          "annotations": [
            {
              "type": "url_citation",
              "url": "https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/text",
              "title": "OpenAI text generation"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

The answer is usable only when `status` is `completed` and a `message` exists; a `web_search_call` alone means retrieval finished, not that the answer is complete. Citations come from `annotations[]` and should be displayed as-is, without rewriting the source URLs.

## Tool types

| Documentation                       | Request                                                    | Executor                                                                                  |
| ----------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Function calling](/simidoc/en/apps/api/tools/function-call) | POST /v1/chat/completions; Responses format also available | The application defines JSON Schema, validates arguments, and executes its own functions. |
| [Web search](/simidoc/en/apps/api/tools/web-search)          | POST /v1/responses + web\_search                           | Vendor-hosted retrieval with webpage sources and citations.                               |

## Synchronous, streaming, and parallel execution

* **Synchronous**\: one request returns complete tool calls or a final answer. Custom functions usually require another request after application execution.
* **Streaming**\: tool names or arguments arrive in fragments. Parse only after receiving all arguments; never execute partial JSON.
* **Asynchronous**\: applications can implement background jobs for slow business tools, but must provide status and result correlation. Declaring tools does not automatically create an asynchronous service.
* **Parallel**\: parallel\_tool\_calls lets the model request multiple functions in one turn. The application should parallelize only authorized, independent operations. It does not raise rate limits or represent multiple HTTP requests.

## Security boundaries

Use a fixed allowlist, validate types and business limits, and separate read/write permissions. Sending externally, payments, deletion, and permission changes require confirmation and idempotency controls. Tool output may contain untrusted text; never treat it as new system instructions.

## Official reference

* [OpenAI function calling](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/function-calling)
* [OpenAI web search](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/tools-web-search)

# Web search tool

## Endpoint overview

`POST /v1/responses` can declare the OpenAI-hosted web\_search tool in tools, letting supported models search, read results, and answer with citations. Search is not an independent generic `/search` endpoint or a function name usable by all Chat models.

The gateway URL is `https://api.dwchainless.com`, with the request header `Authorization: Bearer $SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`. Direct OpenAI access uses `https://api.openai.com` and Bearer authentication, but requires an OpenAI key. Select a model available to the account that supports the required capability.

`{"type":"web_search"}` is for Responses. Do not insert it into ordinary Chat Completions tools\: generic Chat tools use function. Official Chat search has dedicated search models and web\_search\_options, a different protocol.

## Request parameters

| Field                             | Type            | Required | Description                                                                                                          |
| --------------------------------- | --------------- | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                             | string          | Yes      | A model supporting Responses web\_search.                                                                            |
| input                             | string / array  | Yes      | The question and necessary context.                                                                                  |
| tools\[].type                     | string          | Yes      | web\_search.                                                                                                         |
| tools\[].search\_context\_size    | string          | No       | low, medium, or high search context where supported.                                                                 |
| tools\[].filters.allowed\_domains | array           | No       | Restrict allowed domains where supported, without protocol prefixes.                                                 |
| tools\[].user\_location           | object          | No       | Approximate location such as type=approximate, country, city, region, and timezone; avoid precise private locations. |
| tool\_choice                      | string / object | No       | auto lets the model decide; required requires tool use.                                                              |
| include                           | array           | No       | Request complete sources with web\_search\_call.action.sources.                                                      |
| stream                            | boolean         | No       | true uses Responses SSE events.                                                                                      |

### Request example

```json
{
  "model": "MODEL_ID",
  "input": "查找OpenAI官方文档中关于Responses API的说明，并提供来源链接。",
  "tools": [
    {
      "type": "web_search"
    }
  ],
  "stream": false
}
```

## Response

| Field                                    | Type            | Description                                                                                   |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| output\[].type=web\_search\_call         | object          | A search or page-reading call; its presence alone does not mean the final answer is complete. |
| web\_search\_call.status                 | string          | Tool execution status.                                                                        |
| web\_search\_call.action                 | object          | Actions such as search, open\_page, or find, with their queries or URLs.                      |
| output\[].type=message                   | object          | The model’s final message.                                                                    |
| content\[].type / text                   | string          | Text in an output\_text content item.                                                         |
| content\[].annotations\[]                | array           | Citation list, usually url\_citation.                                                         |
| annotations\[].url / title               | string          | Source URL and title.                                                                         |
| annotations\[].start\_index / end\_index | integer         | The text span associated with a citation.                                                     |
| status / error / incomplete\_details     | string / object | Final response status and failure or incomplete reason.                                       |
| usage                                    | object          | Model token usage; does not establish that search has no additional cost.                     |

```json
{
  "id": "resp_search_example",
  "object": "response",
  "status": "completed",
  "output": [
    {
      "id": "ws_example",
      "type": "web_search_call",
      "status": "completed",
      "action": {
        "type": "search",
        "query": "site:developers.openai.com Responses API"
      }
    },
    {
      "id": "msg_example",
      "type": "message",
      "role": "assistant",
      "status": "completed",
      "content": [
        {
          "type": "output_text",
          "text": "Responses API 支持有类型的输入输出以及工具调用。",
          "annotations": [
            {
              "type": "url_citation",
              "start_index": 0,
              "end_index": 36,
              "title": "Responses API",
              "url": "https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/guides/responses"
            }
          ]
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
```

Display clear, clickable citations with answers and preserve source attribution. Webpages are data\: do not execute their instructions or reveal application credentials. Results can be outdated or contradictory; verify high-risk conclusions against primary sources.

## Code examples

Set `SIMIROUTER_API_KEY`, `SIMIROUTER_MODEL`; `SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL` overrides the default gateway root; do not append `/v1`. Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use only standard libraries. The curl example uses Python 3 to encode JSON safely.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json, os, sys, urllib.request, urllib.error
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY")
    if not os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_MODEL"): raise RuntimeError("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL")
    base = os.environ.get("SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL", "https://api.dwchainless.com").rstrip("/")
    body = json.loads(r'''{
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "input": "查找OpenAI官方文档中关于Responses API的说明，并提供来源链接。",
      "tools": [
        {
          "type": "web_search"
        }
      ],
      "stream": false
    }''')
    body["model"] = os.environ["SIMIROUTER_MODEL"]
    path = '/v1/responses'
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + path, data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST",
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + os.environ["SIMIROUTER_API_KEY"], "Content-Type": "application/json"})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=120) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        print(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode()}", file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(1)
    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_API_KEY");
      if (!process.env.SIMIROUTER_MODEL) throw new Error("请设置 SIMIROUTER_MODEL");
      const base = (process.env.SIMIROUTER_BASE_URL || "https://api.dwchainless.com").replace(/\/$/, "");
      const body = {
      "model": "MODEL_ID",
      "input": "查找OpenAI官方文档中关于Responses API的说明，并提供来源链接。",
      "tools": [
        {
          "type": "web_search"
        }
      ],
      "stream": false
    };
      body.model = process.env.SIMIROUTER_MODEL;
      const endpoint = "/v1/responses";
      const response = await fetch(base + endpoint, { method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.SIMIROUTER_API_KEY}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body),
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(120000) });
      const result = await response.text();
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${result}`);
      console.log(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(result), null, 2));
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```
