## Errors

| HTTP / business code               | Description                                                                              |
| ---------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 200 / 0                            | Request succeeded; generation completion still depends on task status.                   |
| 400 / 1201                         | Invalid parameters; read message.                                                        |
| 404 / 1202, 1203                   | Wrong method or missing model/resource.                                                  |
| 401                                | Invalid API key or legacy JWT.                                                           |
| 400 / 1300, 1301                   | Platform policy or content-safety restriction; revise content rather than retry blindly. |
| 429 / 1302, 1303, 1304             | Rate, concurrency, or IP-policy limit.                                                   |
| 500 / 5000; 503 / 5001; 504 / 5002 | Service error or timeout; retain request\_id.                                            |

HTTP 200 is not business success; check code=0 before reading data.

## Official reference

[Kling official API](https\://kling.ai/document-api/apiReference/model/textToVideo), [Authentication](https\://kling.ai/document-api/api/get-started/authentication), [Errors](https\://kling.ai/document-api/api/get-started/error-codes).

# Query Kling text-to-video task

## Endpoint overview

`GET https://api-singapore.klingai.com/tasks` and `Authorization: Bearer $KLING_API_KEY`. New Kling text-to-video and image-to-video use the same task query; do not append `/v1/videos/.../{id}`.

## Request parameters

| Field                       | Type   | Required   | Description                                                                              |
| --------------------------- | ------ | ---------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| task\_ids (query)           | string | Choose one | System task IDs, comma-separated for multiple values.                                    |
| external\_task\_ids (query) | string | Choose one | Values from options.external\_task\_id at creation, comma-separated for multiple values. |

Do not send both query parameters; there is no JSON body. Set `TASK_ID` to the creation response’s `data.id`.

## Response

| Field                             | Description                                                                         |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `code` / `message` / `request_id` | Business status and tracking identifier; parse data only if code=0.                 |
| `data[]`                          | Task array matching the query.                                                      |
| `data[].id` / `external_id`       | System and custom IDs.                                                              |
| `data[].status`                   | submitted, processing, succeeded, failed.                                           |
| `data[].message`                  | Failure reason.                                                                     |
| `data[].outputs[]`                | Distinguishes video/image/audio and other outputs by type, not legacy task\_result. |
| `outputs[].url` / `watermark_url` | Video result URL and available watermarked version.                                 |
| `outputs[].duration`              | Output video duration in seconds.                                                   |
| `create_time` / `update_time`     | Unix-millisecond timestamp.                                                         |
| `billing[]`                       | Returned billing-unit and related information.                                      |

```json
{"code":0,"message":"Success","request_id":"request_example","data":[{"id":"task_example","status":"succeeded","outputs":[{"type":"video","url":"https://example.com/video.mp4","duration":"5"}]}]}
```

Download only when status=succeeded and a valid type=video output exists. Links have access/retention limits; save promptly and stop polling on failure. HTTP success with data=\[] requires checking the ID and account, not marking generation successful.

## Code examples

Set `KLING_API_KEY` and `TASK_ID`; `TASK_ID` must be the actual creation task ID. Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use only standard libraries. curl uses `--data-urlencode` to encode query parameters. Poll every 5–10 seconds with an application-level overall timeout; examples query once only.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json
    import os
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.parse
    import urllib.request

    key = os.environ.get("KLING_API_KEY")
    task_id = os.environ.get("TASK_ID")
    if not key or not task_id or not task_id.strip():
        raise SystemExit("请设置 KLING_API_KEY 和 TASK_ID")
    url = "https://api-singapore.klingai.com/tasks?" + urllib.parse.urlencode({"task_ids": task_id})
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key}, method="GET")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response:
            print(json.dumps(json.load(response), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const key = process.env.KLING_API_KEY;
      const taskId = process.env.TASK_ID;
      if (!key || !taskId?.trim()) throw new Error("请设置 KLING_API_KEY 和 TASK_ID");
      const url = new URL("https://api-singapore.klingai.com/tasks");
      url.searchParams.set("task_ids", taskId);
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "GET", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180000),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
      const result = await response.json();
      if (result.code !== 0) throw new Error(JSON.stringify(result));
      console.log(result);
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```

    ```go
    }
    ```

# PixVerse video

## Overview

PixVerse's official OpenAPI submits asynchronous generation tasks over ordinary HTTP requests. A successful creation returns `video_id`; use the same ID to query status and get the video URL. Text-to-video and image-to-video are separate entry points; image-to-video first uploads an image, then submits with the resulting `img_id`.

| What you want to do            | Input                                                               | Output                                   | Endpoint                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------- |
| Generate a video from text     | Prompt, duration, `quality`, `aspect_ratio`                         | `video_id`                               | `POST /openapi/v2/video/text/generate`    |
| Generate a video from an image | The uploaded image's `img_id` (or template `img_ids`) plus a prompt | `video_id`                               | `POST /openapi/v2/video/img/generate`     |
| Query the task result          | `video_id`                                                          | Status, video URL, actual specifications | `GET /openapi/v2/video/result/{video_id}` |
| Upload an image                | Image file                                                          | `img_id`                                 | `POST /openapi/v2/image/upload`           |

## Core concepts

* **Task lifecycle**\: creation returns `ErrCode=0` and `video_id`, which only means the task was accepted. Query status `1` means complete, `5` generating, `7` content moderation failure, `8` generation failure; `1`, `7`, and `8` are all terminal.
* **The two IDs serve different purposes**\: `video_id` is the business task identifier used for querying and downloading; `Ai-trace-id` is a UUID that must be newly generated for every request. It is for tracing only and is not an idempotency key; reusing it may create another task.
* **Polling cadence**\: the vendor recommends querying every 3–5 seconds. Clients must set an overall wait limit; stop immediately once status reaches `7` or `8` and do not keep retrying the same task.
* **Billing unit**\: `Resp.credits` in the creation response is the credit cost of this task. The actual unit price, plan, and refund rules follow the vendor's pricing page and account bill.
* **Frame and duration are controlled separately**\: text-to-video uses `quality` for the sharpness tier and `aspect_ratio` for the frame; image-to-video has no `aspect_ratio` field, and the frame is determined by the input image or template. Valid `duration` values vary by model; do not fill only the interface's 1–15 range.

## Specifications and capabilities

| Metric           | Verified value                                                                                                                   |
| ---------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Model ID         | `v6-max`, `c1`, `v6`, `v5.6`, `v5.5`, `v5`, `v5-fast`, `v4.5`, `v4`, `v3.5`; `v5-fast` requires account permission               |
| Resolution       | `quality`\: `360p`, `540p`, `720p`, `1080p`                                                                                      |
| Aspect ratio     | Text-to-video\: `16:9`, `9:16`, `4:3`, `3:4`, `1:1`, `2:3`, `3:2`, `21:9`; image-to-video\: no such field                        |
| Duration         | Interface range 1–15 seconds; C1 and V6 are 1–15 seconds, V5.5 and V5.6 are 5, 8, or 10 seconds, older models are 5 or 8 seconds |
| Audio            | `generate_audio_switch` boolean, default `false`; V5.5, V5.6, V6, and C1 support native audio                                    |
| Reference images | Image-to-video uploads first and gets `img_id`; template tasks use `img_ids` with `template_id`                                  |
| Billing metering | The creation response returns `Resp.credits`; the unit price follows the vendor's pricing page                                   |

Choose by model generation first, then by `quality` and `duration`. `quality` only sets the output pixel tier and does not change the frame; `aspect_ratio` only sets the shape, and the final pixels depend on both. Image-to-video has no `aspect_ratio` field, so do not copy the text-to-video request body; the frame follows the input image or template. `Resp.credits` in the creation response is good for budget records, but the actual charge and refund still follow the account bill.

## Call workflow

1. Create an API key on the PixVerse open platform. Requests use the `API-KEY` header; do not write it into prompts or the code repository.
2. For image-to-video, first call `POST /openapi/v2/image/upload` to upload the image and save `Resp.img_id` from the response; skip this step for text-to-video.
3. Submit JSON to the corresponding generation endpoint. Required fields are `model`, `prompt`, `duration`, and `quality`; text-to-video also needs `aspect_ratio`. Generate a new `Ai-trace-id` for each request.
4. Save `Resp.video_id` from the creation response. Do not treat `ErrCode=0` as meaning the video is already generated.
5. Call the query endpoint every 3–5 seconds. Download only when `status=1` and `Resp.url` is reachable; for `status=7`, fix the content before deciding whether to retry; for `status=8`, keep `Ai-trace-id` for troubleshooting.
6. Copy the video to your own storage. The access policy and lifetime of the result URL follow the vendor documentation; do not treat it as a permanent public address.

## Simulated call

The payloads below only illustrate the field structure. Task IDs, credits, and URLs are illustrative values, not real account data.

Creating a text-to-video task\:

```json
{
  "model": "v6-max",
  "prompt": "示例：海边日落，一艘白色帆船缓慢驶过，镜头平稳。",
  "duration": 5,
  "quality": "720p",
  "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
  "seed": 20260804,
  "generate_audio_switch": false
}
```

A successful creation returns only the task ID and consumed credits\:

```json
{
  "ErrCode": 0,
  "ErrMsg": "Success",
  "Resp": {
    "video_id": 900000000000001,
    "credits": 12
  }
}
```

Only `status=1` provides a downloadable address\:

```json
{
  "ErrCode": 0,
  "ErrMsg": "Success",
  "Resp": {
    "id": 900000000000001,
    "status": 1,
    "url": "https://example.com/demo-pixverse.mp4",
    "duration": 5,
    "quality": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9",
    "outputWidth": 1280,
    "outputHeight": 720,
    "has_audio": false,
    "credits": 12
  }
}
```

When `status=5`, keep polling; on `status=7` or `status=8`, end immediately and record the failure reason from `ErrMsg`, `Error.Message`, and `Ai-trace-id`.

## Access and session

* **Base URL**\: `https://app-api.pixverse.ai`. Generation and queries both live under `/openapi/v2/`.
* **Auth headers**\: `API-KEY: PASTE_API_KEY_HERE`; `Content-Type: application/json`; add a new `Ai-trace-id` to every request.
* **Two addresses**\: direct access uses `https://app-api.pixverse.ai` with the `API-KEY` header; use `https://api.dwchainless.com` and `Authorization: Bearer` plus this site's key only when the channel explicitly confirms this gateway mapping; do not assume that replacing the address and authentication is sufficient. Whether a SimiRouter channel maps these paths or switches to a unified video protocol depends on the channel configuration; do not assume field compatibility just by changing the domain.
* **Timeout and idempotency**\: a creation timeout does not prove that the server did not accept the task. Query with the saved `video_id` first and retry only after confirming it does not exist; do not submit the same prompt repeatedly to "hurry it along".
* **Error detection**\: HTTP 200 may still carry a nonzero `ErrCode`. For business errors, read `ErrCode`, `ErrMsg`, and the optional `Error.Type` and `Error.Param`; do not look only at the HTTP status code.

## Official references

* [PixVerse Quick Start](https\://docs.platform.pixverse.ai/quick-start-2394985m0)
* [PixVerse text-to-video API](https\://docs.platform.pixverse.ai/text-to-video-generation-13016634e0)
* [PixVerse image-to-video API](https\://docs.platform.pixverse.ai/image-to-video-generation-13016633e0)
* [PixVerse query task status](https\://docs.platform.pixverse.ai/query-task-status-43051212e0)

# Create Seedance video task

## Endpoint overview

`POST https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks`, `Authorization: Bearer $ARK_API_KEY`, with a JSON body. The following is the official direct protocol, **not** a guaranteed mapping to SimiRouter `/v1/video/generations`.

## Request parameters

| Field                     | Type      | Required    | Description                                                                                                                                               |
| ------------------------- | --------- | ----------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model                     | string    | Yes         | An enabled Seedance model ID or inference-endpoint ID.                                                                                                    |
| content                   | object\[] | Yes         | Text and model-supported image/video/audio content items.                                                                                                 |
| content\[].type           | string    | Yes         | text, image\_url, video\_url, audio\_url, or draft\_task according to model capabilities.                                                                 |
| content\[].draft\_task.id | string    | Conditional | Draft task ID when type=draft\_task, used to render a final video from a draft.                                                                           |
| content\[].text           | string    | Conditional | The prompt for type=text.                                                                                                                                 |
| content\[].image\_url.url | string    | Conditional | An accessible image or model-permitted data URL.                                                                                                          |
| content\[].role           | string    | No          | For example, first\_frame, last\_frame, or reference\_image; use according to model and asset type.                                                       |
| resolution                | string    | No          | A model-permitted resolution\: 480p, 720p, 1080p, or 4k depending on the model; drafts support 480p only.                                                 |
| ratio                     | string    | No          | For example, 16\:9, 9\:16, 1\:1 or adaptive; consult the model capability table.                                                                          |
| duration                  | integer   | No          | Video duration, with model-specific limits; -1 for models supporting automatic duration.                                                                  |
| frames                    | integer   | No          | Frame count, only where supported; when sent with duration, frames takes precedence.                                                                      |
| generate\_audio           | boolean   | No          | Whether to generate an audio track; audio-capable models only.                                                                                            |
| watermark                 | boolean   | No          | Visible watermark settings; follow synthetic-content labeling requirements.                                                                               |
| seed                      | integer   | No          | Random seed; reproducibility is not a pixel-perfect guarantee.                                                                                            |
| return\_last\_frame       | boolean   | No          | Request the last-frame image.                                                                                                                             |
| callback\_url             | string    | No          | Status-change callback URL; receivers must handle duplicates and out-of-order notifications.                                                              |
| execution\_expires\_after | integer   | No          | Task expiration in seconds; default 172,800, range 3,600–259,200.                                                                                         |
| service\_tier             | string    | No          | default / flex, according to model support.                                                                                                               |
| draft                     | boolean   | No          | Create a draft video; defaults to false and accepts 480p only on supported models. To render a final video from a draft, use `content[].type=draft_task`. |
| priority                  | integer   | No          | Queue priority for supported models/service tiers; not universal.                                                                                         |

This example selects Seedance 2.5 with text-only input and short-video settings. For 1.0 pro / 2.0, adjust fields to that version’s capabilities; do not assume all multimodal references, audio, or drafts are available.

## Response

Successful creation returns `id`, not a finished video. Save the ID, then use [Query task status](/simidoc/en/apps/api/video/seedance/status).

```json
{"id":"cgt-example"}
```

A timeout does not prove the server rejected the request. Avoid unlimited automatic resubmission. Callback receivers should update state idempotently by task ID.

## Code examples

Python examples require `python3 -m pip install requests`; Node.js uses version 18+ with built-in fetch; Go uses standard libraries.

Set the official `ARK_API_KEY`; this creates a potentially billable task.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import os
    import requests

    url = 'https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks'
    headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['ARK_API_KEY']}
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status           | Meaning and action                                                                                                        |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400 / 422             | Invalid fields, file format, or model parameters; correct before resubmitting.                                            |
| 401                   | Missing, invalid, or expired API key.                                                                                     |
| 403                   | No access to the project or model.                                                                                        |
| 404                   | Model, route, or task not found; check the address and resource ownership.                                                |
| 413 / 415             | Upload too large or unsupported media type.                                                                               |
| 429                   | Rate or quota limit; distinguish insufficient funds from retryable throttling.                                            |
| 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 | Service or upstream failure. Keep the request ID; after a creation timeout, check acceptance before creating a duplicate. |

Volcengine error objects use `error.code`, `error.message` and retain a request ID. Generation failures also require reading task-query results; creation HTTP status does not establish final success.

Volcengine errors use `error.code`, `error.message` and request IDs; read generation failures from the query result’s error field as well.

## Official reference

[Volcengine Ark create task](https\://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/create-video-generation-task-api?lang=zh), [Official integration tutorial](https\://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/video-generation-tutorial?lang=zh).

# Seedance video

## Endpoint overview

Seedance supports text-to-video and model-permitted image, video, and audio references. The official Ark workflow creates an asynchronous task, polls status, and downloads after success.

| Operation | Official path                                 | Documentation           |
| --------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----------------------- |
| Create    | `POST /api/v3/contents/generations/tasks`     | [Create task](/simidoc/en/apps/api/video/seedance/create) |
| Query     | `GET /api/v3/contents/generations/tasks/{id}` | [Query task](/simidoc/en/apps/api/video/seedance/status)  |

Official base URL `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com` and `ARK_API_KEY` with Bearer authentication. `/v1/video/generations` is a compatible gateway path, not an official Ark address. Use it only with an explicit channel mapping; do not automatically rewrite id/status into another vendor’s format.

Statuses are `queued → running → succeeded`; failed terminal states include failed, expired, and cancelled. It is neither SSE nor Realtime. Model versions determine audio, reference, duration, and resolution support.

## Official reference

[Create video task](https\://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/create-video-generation-task-api?lang=zh), [Query task](https\://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/get-video-generation-task-api?lang=zh), [Video tutorial](https\://docs.volcengine.com/docs/ark/video-generation-tutorial?lang=zh).

# Query Seedance video task

## Endpoint overview

`GET https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks/{id}`, authentication `Authorization: Bearer $ARK_API_KEY`. This page uses the official Ark protocol, not generic gateway video statuses.

## Request parameters

| Field     | Type   | Required | Description                                                 |
| --------- | ------ | -------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| id (path) | string | Yes      | The cgt- task ID from creation, in the same account/region. |

No JSON body. Task IDs generally remain valid for seven days; some newly created Draft tasks have separate lifetimes. Do not use task endpoints as permanent archives.

## Response

| Field                                                   | Description                                                          |
| ------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id` / `model`                                          | Task ID and model version.                                           |
| `status`                                                | queued, running, succeeded, failed, expired, cancelled.              |
| `content.video_url`                                     | Result URL after success, usually valid for 24 hours; save promptly. |
| `content.last_frame_url`                                | Last-frame image URL when requested and supported.                   |
| `error.code` / `error.message`                          | Failure reason; may be empty.                                        |
| `created_at` / `updated_at`                             | Unix-second timestamp.                                               |
| `usage`                                                 | Task usage statistics, model-dependent.                              |
| `duration` / `ratio` / `resolution` / `framespersecond` | Actual video specifications.                                         |
| `seed` / `service_tier` / `execution_expires_after`     | Execution settings and reproducibility information.                  |

```json
{"id":"cgt-example","model":"doubao-seedance-2-5-260628","status":"succeeded","content":{"video_url":"https://example.com/video.mp4"},"error":null,"created_at":1780000000,"updated_at":1780000120}
```

Download only when succeeded and video\_url is nonempty. Stop polling immediately for failed, expired, or cancelled. Example URLs illustrate fields only.

## Code examples

Set `ARK_API_KEY` and `TASK_ID`; `TASK_ID` must be the actual creation task ID. Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use only standard libraries. curl additionally requires Python 3 for safe path encoding. Poll every 5–10 seconds with an application-level overall timeout; examples query once only.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json
    import os
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.parse
    import urllib.request

    key = os.environ.get("ARK_API_KEY")
    task_id = os.environ.get("TASK_ID")
    if not key or not task_id or not task_id.strip():
        raise SystemExit("请设置 ARK_API_KEY 和 TASK_ID")
    url = "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks/" + urllib.parse.quote(task_id, safe="")
    request = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key}, method="GET")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=180) as response:
            print(json.dumps(json.load(response), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const key = process.env.ARK_API_KEY;
      const taskId = process.env.TASK_ID;
      if (!key || !taskId?.trim()) throw new Error("请设置 ARK_API_KEY 和 TASK_ID");
      const url = "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks/" + encodeURIComponent(taskId);
      const response = await fetch(url, {
        method: "GET", headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}` },
        signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180000),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
      console.log(await response.text());
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="curl">
    ```bash
    set -euo pipefail
    : "${ARK_API_KEY:?请设置 ARK_API_KEY}"
    : "${TASK_ID:?请设置 TASK_ID 为创建接口返回的真实任务 ID}"
    TASK_PATH=$(python3 - <<'PY_TASK'
    import os, urllib.parse
    task_id = os.environ["TASK_ID"]
    if not task_id.strip():
        raise SystemExit("TASK_ID 不能为空白")
    print(urllib.parse.quote(task_id, safe=""))
    PY_TASK
    )
    curl "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks/${TASK_PATH}" \
      --fail-with-body \
      --connect-timeout 15 \
      --max-time 180 \
      --header "Authorization: Bearer $ARK_API_KEY"
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Go">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
    	"fmt"
    	"io"
    	"log"
    	"net/http"
    	"net/url"
    	"os"
    	"strings"
    	"time"
    )

    func check(err error) {
    	if err != nil {
    		log.Fatal(err)
    	}
    }
    func main() {
    	key, taskID := os.Getenv("ARK_API_KEY"), os.Getenv("TASK_ID")
    	if key == "" || strings.TrimSpace(taskID) == "" {
    		log.Fatal("请设置 ARK_API_KEY 和 TASK_ID")
    	}
    	endpoint := "https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3/contents/generations/tasks/" + url.PathEscape(taskID)
    	req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", endpoint, nil)
    	check(err)
    	req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+key)
    	client := &http.Client{Timeout: 180 * time.Second}
    	response, err := client.Do(req)
    	check(err)
    	defer response.Body.Close()
    	data, err := io.ReadAll(response.Body)
    	check(err)
    	if response.StatusCode < 200 || response.StatusCode >= 300 {
    		log.Fatalf("HTTP %d: %s", response.StatusCode, data)
    	}
    	fmt.Println(string(data))
    }
    ```

# Download Sora content (official API closed)

**Official OpenAI Sora 2 and Videos API closed on September 24, 2026.** The following retains interface structure only, not usable integration instructions. Any same-named SimiRouter models or third-party compatible implementations require separate source, capability, and protocol verification; they are not official direct OpenAI access.

## Endpoint overview

`GET https://api.openai.com/v1/videos/REPLACE_WITH_VIDEO_ID/content` was the official request format using an OpenAI Bearer key; do not send new production requests now.

## Request parameters

| Field            | Type   | Required | Description                                                     |
| ---------------- | ------ | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| video\_id (path) | string | Yes      | The original creation task ID.                                  |
| variant (query)  | string | No       | Former content types such as video, thumbnail, and spritesheet. |

## Response

Former successful responses contained binary video MP4 or other content, not URL JSON; downloads required completed generation. This official content service is now closed.

## Code examples

Python examples require `python3 -m pip install requests`; Node.js uses version 18+ with built-in fetch; Go uses standard libraries.

**Archived examples do not establish that the endpoint still works.** The following illustrates the former HTTP structure; do not test new tasks with real keys.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import os
    import requests
    from pathlib import Path

    url = 'https://api.openai.com/v1/videos/REPLACE_WITH_VIDEO_ID/content'
    headers = {'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + os.environ['OPENAI_API_KEY']}
    response = requests.request('GET', url, headers=headers, timeout=180)
    response.raise_for_status()
    Path('video.mp4').write_bytes(response.content)
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const url = "https://api.openai.com/v1/videos/REPLACE_WITH_VIDEO_ID/content";
      const headers = { "Authorization": "Bearer " + process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY };
      const response = await fetch(url, { method: "GET", headers, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(180000) });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
      const { writeFile } = require("node:fs/promises");
      await writeFile("video.mp4", Buffer.from(await response.arrayBuffer()));
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="curl">
    ```bash
    set -eu
    [ ! -e "video.mp4" ] || { printf '%s\n' "目标文件已存在：video.mp4" >&2; exit 1; }
    temporary=$(mktemp)
    trap 'rm -f "$temporary"' EXIT
    if curl --fail-with-body --max-time 180 -X GET "https://api.openai.com/v1/videos/REPLACE_WITH_VIDEO_ID/content" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPENAI_API_KEY" \
      --output "$temporary"; then
      mv "$temporary" "video.mp4"
    else
      status=$?
      cat "$temporary" >&2
      exit "$status"
    fi
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Go">
    ```go

    )

        req, err := http.NewRequest("GET", "https://api.openai.com/v1/videos/REPLACE_WITH_VIDEO_ID/content", nil); check(err)
      req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer " + os.Getenv("OPENAI_API_KEY"))
      client := &http.Client{Timeout: 180 * time.Second}
      res, err := client.Do(req); check(err)
      defer res.Body.Close()
      data, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body); check(err)
      if res.StatusCode < 200 || res.StatusCode >= 300 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s", res.StatusCode, data)) }
      check(os.WriteFile("video.mp4", data, 0600))
    }
    ```

## Errors

After closure, no successful response can be promised. The former endpoint used HTTP 401/403 for authentication/permissions, 404 for missing resources, and 429 for rate limits; generation failures also included error.code/message. Do not endlessly retry retired endpoints or save error bodies as MP4.

## Official reference

[OpenAI deprecation notice](https\://developers.openai.com/api/docs/deprecations#2026-03-24-sora-2-video-generation-models-and-videos-api), [Videos API](https\://developers.openai.com/api/reference/resources/videos/methods/create).

# Dots video understanding

## Endpoint overview

`dots3-note-prev` supports video input, combining videos, images, and questions in one message-content array for textual analysis. The official video protocol uses `POST https://note3-prev-api.askdiandian.com/v1/chat/completions`, with the request header `api-key: $DOTS_API_KEY`, not Bearer authentication.

Examples connect directly to **the official Dots service**. This is neither Gemini’s `input/steps` protocol nor an asynchronous video-generation task. For SimiRouter, verify model and channel passthrough of this video extension; replacing the domain and key alone is insufficient.

* `stream: false`\: waits for complete JSON; the final answer is in `choices[].message.content`.
* `stream: true`\: receives text deltas over SSE. Video processing may increase time to first token; allow sufficient client timeout.
* Videos must be file URLs readable by the model service. Official video examples do not specify Base64, `ms://`, frame-sampling rates, maximum duration, or fixed file-size parameters; this page does not claim those methods are supported.

## Request parameters

The request body is `application/json`.

| Field                                  | Type                     | Required                 | Description                                                                                                 |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`                                | string                   | Yes                      | The official example model is `dots3-note-prev`.                                                            |
| `messages`                             | array                    | Yes                      | Submit message history in order.                                                                            |
| `messages[].role`                      | string                   | Yes                      | Place the video and question in `user`; optional `system` instructions.                                     |
| `messages[].content`                   | array                    | Yes                      | Video requests require a content array, not a serialized string.                                            |
| `content[].type`                       | string                   | Yes                      | `video_url` for the video and `text` for the question; optionally include `image_url` images.               |
| `content[].video_url.url`              | string                   | Required for video items | A video-file URL accessible to the model service, not a local path or website share page.                   |
| `content[].text`                       | string                   | Required for text items  | The analysis task to perform.                                                                               |
| `stream`                               | boolean                  | No                       | Examples on this page use `false`; for `true`, switch to SSE parsing                                        |
| `max_tokens`                           | integer                  | No                       | Maximum output tokens; 4,096 here. Input plus this limit must not exceed the model’s 524,288-token context. |
| `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking` | boolean                  | No                       | Default `true`; `false` disables deep thinking; this example explicitly enables it.                         |
| `stop`                                 | string\[]                | No                       | An array of stop sequences; matching ends generation.                                                       |
| `tools` / `tool_choice`                | array / string or object | No                       | Function definitions and tool selection; this example analyzes video without tools.                         |

Public video links are downloaded by Dots. Use URLs you are authorized to disclose to the model service; signed URLs need sufficient validity and must not contain account-login credentials. A Xiaohongshu share page is not a direct video-file link.

## Response

HTTP 200 returns Chat Completions JSON. The following illustrates structure; content, IDs, and usage are not measured test records.

| Field                                            | Type             | Description                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------------------------ | ---------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `id` / `object`                                  | string           | Request identifier; non-streaming `object` is `chat.completion`.                                             |
| `created` / `model`                              | integer / string | Unix-second time and responding model.                                                                       |
| `choices[].index`                                | integer          | Candidate index.                                                                                             |
| `choices[].message.role`                         | string           | The assistant message is `assistant`.                                                                        |
| `choices[].message.content`                      | string           | The final textual answer.                                                                                    |
| `choices[].message.reasoning_content`            | string, optional | Reasoning content that may appear when thinking is enabled; handle separately from the final answer.         |
| `choices[].finish_reason`                        | string           | `stop` means normal completion; `length` means truncation; `tool_calls` requires application tool execution. |
| `usage.prompt_tokens`                            | integer          | Input tokens; video follows the service’s multimodal accounting rules.                                       |
| `usage.completion_tokens` / `usage.total_tokens` | integer          | Generated and total usage.                                                                                   |
| `system_fingerprint`                             | string, optional | Server-provided system identifier; may be an empty string.                                                   |

```json
{
  "id": "dots_video_example",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1793500000,
  "model": "dots3-note-prev",
  "choices": [{
    "index": 0,
    "message": {"role": "assistant", "content": "视频先展示室外场景，随后人物走入画面。"},
    "finish_reason": "stop"
  }],
  "usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1200, "completion_tokens": 100, "total_tokens": 1300}
}
```

Streaming uses Chat Completions deltas; read response text from `choices[].delta.content` and accumulate thinking separately. Handle SSE event boundaries, terminal status, and stream completion. One network read is not necessarily a complete event; a disconnect or `length` is not a complete answer.

## Code examples

Set `DOTS_API_KEY` and `VIDEO_URL`. `VIDEO_URL` must be an HTTP(S) video-file URL directly readable by the model service. None of the four examples downloads it locally first. `DOTS_BASE_URL` is optional, default `https://note3-prev-api.askdiandian.com`; the root URL excludes `/v1`. Change only for authorized native-protocol proxies or local testing.

Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go use standard libraries; curl requires Python 3 to construct JSON safely and validate results. Requests wait up to 300 seconds without automatic retries. Examples output text only when `finish_reason=stop` and the answer is nonempty.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import json, os, urllib.error, urllib.parse, urllib.request
    key, video = os.environ.get("DOTS_API_KEY"), os.environ.get("VIDEO_URL")
    if not key or not video: raise SystemExit("请设置 DOTS_API_KEY 和 VIDEO_URL")
    url = urllib.parse.urlsplit(video)
    if url.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not url.hostname or url.username is not None or url.password is not None:
        raise SystemExit("VIDEO_URL 必须是不含登录凭据的 HTTP(S) 视频文件地址")
    body = {"model": "dots3-note-prev", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
        {"type": "video_url", "video_url": {"url": video}},
        {"type": "text", "text": "概括视频内容，并按顺序列出关键事件。"}
    ]}], "stream": False, "max_tokens": 4096, "chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": True}}
    base = os.environ.get("DOTS_BASE_URL", "https://note3-prev-api.askdiandian.com").rstrip("/")
    request = urllib.request.Request(base + "/v1/chat/completions", data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
        headers={"api-key": key, "Content-Type": "application/json"}, method="POST")
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=300) as response: result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")
    choices = result.get("choices") or []
    if not choices or choices[0].get("finish_reason") != "stop": raise RuntimeError("视频分析未正常完成")
    answer = choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content")
    if not isinstance(answer, str) or not answer.strip(): raise RuntimeError("响应没有最终文字答案")
    print(answer)
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    async function main() {
      const key = process.env.DOTS_API_KEY, video = process.env.VIDEO_URL;
      if (!key || !video) throw new Error("请设置 DOTS_API_KEY 和 VIDEO_URL");
      const url = new URL(video);
      if (!["http:", "https:"].includes(url.protocol) || !url.hostname || url.username || url.password)
        throw new Error("VIDEO_URL 必须是不含登录凭据的 HTTP(S) 视频文件地址");
      const body = {model:"dots3-note-prev",messages:[{role:"user",content:[
        {type:"video_url",video_url:{url:video}},
        {type:"text",text:"概括视频内容，并按顺序列出关键事件。"}
      ]}],stream:false,max_tokens:4096,chat_template_kwargs:{enable_thinking:true}};
      const base = (process.env.DOTS_BASE_URL || "https://note3-prev-api.askdiandian.com").replace(/\/$/, "");
      const response = await fetch(base + "/v1/chat/completions", {method:"POST",
        headers:{"api-key":key,"Content-Type":"application/json"},body:JSON.stringify(body),signal:AbortSignal.timeout(300000)});
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
      const result = await response.json(), choice = result.choices?.[0];
      if (choice?.finish_reason !== "stop") throw new Error("视频分析未正常完成");
      const answer = choice.message?.content;
      if (typeof answer !== "string" || !answer.trim()) throw new Error("响应没有最终文字答案");
      console.log(answer);
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status | Official meaning                    | Action                                                                          |
| ----------- | ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400         | Invalid parameters or JSON          | Check the multimodal array, video link, model name, and context length          |
| 401         | Missing or invalid API key          | Check the Dots key and `api-key` header                                         |
| 403         | The key cannot access this resource | Check platform permissions                                                      |
| 429         | Too many requests                   | Reduce concurrency and use bounded backoff                                      |
| 500         | Internal service error              | Retain sanitized error bodies and response identifiers; avoid unlimited retries |

HTTP 200 does not guarantee completeness; still inspect `finish_reason` and the textual answer. For expired URLs, download failures, or parsing errors, diagnose the actual error body rather than assume authentication failure. A client timeout does not guarantee the service did not execute; beware duplicate usage before resubmitting.

## Official reference

[Dots API\: video input](https\://dots.ai/platform/docs#video-input), [Request parameters](https\://dots.ai/platform/docs#request-parameters), [Authentication](https\://dots.ai/platform/docs#authentication) and [Response statuses](https\://dots.ai/platform/docs#error-codes).

# Gemini video understanding

## Endpoint overview

Video understanding takes existing videos and returns textual analysis, not new videos. The following uses **Google’s official Interactions API**\: `POST https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions` with authentication `x-goog-api-key: $GEMINI_API_KEY`. It is not Seedance/Kling task creation and does not imply SimiRouter maps every Google media-input capability.

## Request parameters

| Field               | Type    | Required    | Description                                                                                    |
| ------------------- | ------- | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| model               | string  | Yes         | A video-input model, such as gemini-3.8-flash.                                                 |
| input               | array   | Yes         | video assets and text questions.                                                               |
| input\[].type       | string  | Yes         | video or text.                                                                                 |
| input\[].data       | string  | Conditional | Base64 content for short videos; choose this or uri.                                           |
| input\[].mime\_type | string  | Conditional | For example, video/mp4, matching the actual encoding.                                          |
| input\[].uri        | string  | Conditional | An uploaded Google file URI in ACTIVE state, or a public video URL supported by the model.     |
| input\[].text       | string  | Conditional | A summary, question, or query about a specific time range.                                     |
| stream / background | boolean | No          | Long analyses can use streaming or background mode with the corresponding event/task workflow. |

This example conservatively uses a short MP4 with total request size below 20 MB. Prefer Google Files API for larger or reused videos. Wait for ACTIVE after upload; stop for FAILED and bound polling. Public URLs, Cloud Storage, and inline data are distinct input paths and not freely interchangeable.

## Response

Interactions `steps[]` contains model\_output, with text items at `content[].type=text` and their content in `text`. SDK output\_text is a convenience property. Timestamps are model interpretations\: verify against the original video rather than treat them as precise forensic evidence or frame annotations.

```json
{"steps":[{"type":"model_output","content":[{"type":"text","text":"00:10 出现海面上的帆船，随后镜头向右移动。"}]}]}
```

## Code examples

Python examples require `python3 -m pip install requests`; Node.js uses version 18+ with built-in fetch; Go uses standard libraries.

Prepare a short video `video.mp4` and set Google’s official `GEMINI_API_KEY`. Examples do not call paid generation models or file-management operations, but inference itself may still incur charges.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import os
    import base64
    from pathlib import Path
    import requests

    url = 'https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/interactions'
    headers = {'x-goog-api-key': '' + os.environ['GEMINI_API_KEY']}
    response = requests.request('POST', url, headers=headers, json={'model': 'gemini-3.8-flash', 'input': [{'type': 'text', 'text': '总结视频内容，并列出关键事件对应的时间点。'}, {'type': 'video', 'mime_type': 'video/mp4', 'data': base64.b64encode(Path('video.mp4').read_bytes()).decode("ascii")}]}, timeout=180)
    response.raise_for_status()
    print(response.text)
    ```
  </Tab>

## Errors

| HTTP status           | Meaning and action                                                                                                                                     |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 400 / 422             | Invalid fields, file format, or model parameters; correct before resubmitting.                                                                         |
| 401                   | Missing, invalid, or expired API key.                                                                                                                  |
| 403                   | No access to the project or model.                                                                                                                     |
| 404                   | Model, route, or input resource not found; check the address, model ID, and file state.                                                                |
| 413 / 415             | Upload too large or unsupported media type.                                                                                                            |
| 429                   | Rate or quota limit; distinguish insufficient funds from retryable throttling.                                                                         |
| 500 / 502 / 503 / 504 | Service or upstream failure. Keep the request ID; after a synchronous timeout, check logs or request state before retrying to avoid duplicate charges. |

Google errors use `error.code`, `error.status`, `error.message`; do not treat the error body as a normal analysis result.

## Official reference

[Google video understanding](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video-understanding), [Files](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/files).

# Video understanding

Video understanding takes existing video and returns summaries, scene descriptions, event sequences, or answers; it does not generate new video from prompts. Dots, Kimi, and Gemini support video input with different content formats, file references, and authentication.

## Vendors and protocols

| Documentation                          | Official example model | Video input                                                 | Request and response                                                          |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Dots video understanding](/simidoc/en/apps/api/video/understanding/dots)     | `dots3-note-prev`      | A model-service-accessible `video_url.url`                  | Chat Completions message arrays; final text is in `choices[].message.content` |
| [Kimi video understanding](/simidoc/en/apps/api/video/understanding/kimi)     | `kimi-k3`              | Base64 video data URLs, or Moonshot `ms://` file references | Chat Completions message arrays; final text is in `choices[].message.content` |
| [Gemini video understanding](/simidoc/en/apps/api/video/understanding/gemini) | `gemini-3.8-flash`     | Inline video data or Google-supported file URIs             | This page uses Interactions; text is in `steps[].content[]`                   |

Dots video requests use the official `api-key` header; Kimi uses Bearer; Gemini uses `x-goog-api-key`. Dots and Kimi use `video_url` as a vendor-specific multimodal extension, not a video standard supported by every OpenAI-compatible service. Sharing the `/v1/chat/completions` path does not make video payloads interchangeable.

## Synchronous, streaming, and file references

* **Non-streaming**\: one HTTP request waits for a complete textual response, without a video-generation task ID.
* **Streaming**\: SSE delivers text increments. Video download, decoding, and analysis may still precede the first event. Streaming is not continuous camera upload and does not guarantee immediate first text.
* **File references**\: upload to vendor storage first, then reference it in analysis. Upload completion is not analysis completion, and file IDs are not interchangeable across vendors.
* **Parallel requests**\: the client issues independent requests, each with its own limits, context, and usage; this is not a “parallel” body parameter.

## Preparing input

Use videos you are authorized to process. Direct public links, share pages, local paths, and Base64 are different inputs and must follow the protocol. Xiaohongshu and other share pages are not downloadable video URLs; login-protected or hotlink-protected videos may also be inaccessible to the model service.

Duration, resolution, sampled frames, and file size affect latency, tokens, and cost; consult vendor limits. Verify timestamps and event judgments against the original video; they are not exact frame-level forensic evidence or forced alignment.

## SimiRouter integration

These pages provide official direct-vendor examples requiring vendor keys. For SimiRouter, verify the account’s exact model ID, channel video mapping, and file-reference support. Official model support does not establish successful platform integration. Vendor keys and SimiRouter keys are not interchangeable.

## Official reference

* [Dots\: video input](https\://dots.ai/platform/docs#video-input)
* [Kimi K3 quickstart](https\://platform.kimi.com/docs/guide/kimi-k3-quickstart) and [Vision models](https\://platform.kimi.com/docs/guide/use-kimi-vision-model)
* [Google\: video understanding](https\://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/video-understanding)

# Kimi video understanding

## Endpoint overview

`kimi-k3` natively supports video understanding for summaries, visual questions, and event analysis. It returns text, not video, and does not guarantee frame-by-frame recognition or precise temporal alignment.

**Endpoint address**\: `POST https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions`. Use a China-site Moonshot API key with `Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY` authentication. The international site uses `https://api.moonshot.ai` and an international key; accounts and keys cannot be mixed across the two sites.

Examples on this page use **Official direct Moonshot access**. A model’s video capability does not establish equivalent SimiRouter model, media input, or file-storage support. Do not transfer `ms://` file IDs directly to other vendors or gateways.

* **Non-streaming**\: `stream: false`; one HTTP request waits for complete JSON.
* **Streaming**\: `stream: true`; the same connection streams reasoning and answer deltas over SSE, not an asynchronous video-generation task.
* **File references**\: upload first, then use `ms://<file_id>` in the chat request; uploading does not replace the chat request.

## Request parameters

The content type is `application/json`.

| Field                          | Type                     | Required    | Description                                                                                                                  |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------ | ----------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `model`                        | string                   | Yes         | This page uses `kimi-k3`, not a display name or abbreviated model label.                                                     |
| `messages`                     | array                    | Yes         | Message list. User messages containing video require content arrays.                                                         |
| `messages[].role`              | string                   | Yes         | Place videos and questions in a `user` message; optional `system` instructions.                                              |
| `messages[].content`           | array                    | Yes         | Contains a `video_url` video item and a `text` question item; do not serialize the array as a string.                        |
| `content[].type`               | string                   | Yes         | For video use `video_url`; for text use `text`.                                                                              |
| `content[].video_url.url`      | string                   | Conditional | `data:video/mp4;base64,...` or other data URLs matching the actual MIME type, or a Moonshot file reference `ms://<file_id>`. |
| `content[].text`               | string                   | Conditional | The requested analysis, such as summaries, event order, or questions about specified time ranges.                            |
| `reasoning_effort`             | string                   | No          | K3 always enables thinking and uses top-level `low`, `high` or `max`, default `max`.                                         |
| `max_completion_tokens`        | integer                  | No          | The generation token limit; budget for reasoning and the final answer. When reached, `finish_reason` is `length`.            |
| `stream`                       | boolean                  | No          | Default `false`; `true` returns SSE.                                                                                         |
| `stream_options.include_usage` | boolean                  | No          | With streaming, retrieve a usage chunk before completion.                                                                    |
| `response_format`              | object                   | No          | Supported structured-output format; configure official JSON Mode or JSON Schema when JSON is required.                       |
| `tools` / `tool_choice`        | array / string or object | No          | Tool calling is available; the video-analysis example on this page does not enable it.                                       |

K3 does not use K2.x’s `thinking` switch. `temperature` is always `1.0`, `top_p` is always `0.95`, `n` is always `1`, with repetition penalties fixed at `0`; omit these fields, as other values cause errors. `max_tokens` is a legacy parameter; new integrations use `max_completion_tokens`.

### Video input limits

The official vision page lists MP4, MPEG, MOV, AVI, FLV, MPG, WebM, WMV, and 3GPP and recommends resolution no higher than 1080p. The request body must satisfy the official 100M limit. Base64 enlarges payloads; original video size is not JSON request size.

Examples use a more conservative **20 MiB local-video limit**, an example safeguard, not a maximum-capacity or duration guarantee. Use the official upload workflow for larger or repeatedly referenced videos. Do not put ordinary webpages, Xiaohongshu share pages, or local paths in `video_url.url`; this page uses the verified Base64 and `ms://` input methods.

### Using uploaded videos

Call Moonshot `POST /v1/files` with multipart `file` and `purpose=video`, read the upload response’s `id`, then use `{"type":"video_url","video_url":{"url":"ms://<file_id>"}}` in the video item. There is no need to retrieve extracted file text.

The official upload reference lists a 100 MiB per-file limit. New file-protocol versions must follow their `kimi-api-version` requirements; do not apply file-endpoint version headers to Chat Completions. Access resources through the same platform and account, then delete according to retention rules.

## Response

A successful non-streaming response is HTTP 200 JSON using Chat Completions structure.

| Field                                 | Type    | Description                                                                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `id`                                  | string  | The completion identifier.                                                                                                         |
| `object`                              | string  | For non-streaming responses, `chat.completion`.                                                                                    |
| `created`                             | integer | Creation time in Unix seconds.                                                                                                     |
| `model`                               | string  | The response model identifier.                                                                                                     |
| `choices[].index`                     | integer | The candidate index.                                                                                                               |
| `choices[].message.role`              | string  | The assistant message is `assistant`.                                                                                              |
| `choices[].message.content`           | string  | The final video-analysis answer.                                                                                                   |
| `choices[].message.reasoning_content` | string  | Optional reasoning content; not the final answer and must not be merged with `content`.                                            |
| `choices[].finish_reason`             | string  | `stop` means normal completion; `length` means the generation limit was reached; `tool_calls` requests application tool execution. |
| `usage.prompt_tokens`                 | integer | Input usage, including model-accounted video input.                                                                                |
| `usage.completion_tokens`             | integer | Generated usage.                                                                                                                   |
| `usage.total_tokens`                  | integer | Total usage, optionally with caching and reasoning breakdowns.                                                                     |

The following IDs, times, and usage illustrate structure only, not measured calls\:

```json
{
  "id": "chatcmpl_example",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1793500000,
  "model": "kimi-k3",
  "choices": [
    {
      "index": 0,
      "message": {
        "role": "assistant",
        "content": "视频先展示产品外观，随后演示操作步骤，最后对比使用前后的结果。"
      },
      "finish_reason": "stop"
    }
  ],
  "usage": {
    "prompt_tokens": 1200,
    "completion_tokens": 300,
    "total_tokens": 1500
  }
}
```

### Parsing streams

In SSE `data:` JSON, `choices[].delta.reasoning_content` contains reasoning deltas and `choices[].delta.content` contains answer-text deltas. Append them separately rather than overwrite. Check the final `finish_reason` and wait for `data: [DONE]`. With usage enabled, the statistics chunk may have `choices: []`; read from top-level `usage` rather than hard-code `choices[0]`.

For multi-turn conversations, preserve the complete assistant message, including returned `reasoning_content`, and include required video and question context on the next turn. A disconnect or `length` is not a complete answer.

## Code examples

First set `MOONSHOT_API_KEY` and `VIDEO_FILE`; the latter is an actual local video you are authorized to upload. `VIDEO_MIME` is optional, default `video/mp4`, matching the actual file; examples do not convert arbitrary files to MP4. `MOONSHOT_BASE_URL` is optional, default `https://api.moonshot.cn`; the root URL excludes `/v1`, for authorized proxies or local mock tests.

Python 3, Node.js 18+, and Go examples use standard libraries; curl requires Python 3 for request encoding and response parsing. All four enforce the 20 MiB video limit, set timeouts, reject incomplete results, and do not automatically retry billable requests.

<Tabs items={["Python","Node.js","curl","Go"]}>
  <Tab value="Python">
    ```python
    import base64
    import json
    import os
    import urllib.error
    import urllib.request
    from pathlib import Path

    key = os.environ.get("MOONSHOT_API_KEY")
    filename = os.environ.get("VIDEO_FILE")
    if not key or not filename:
        raise SystemExit("请设置 MOONSHOT_API_KEY 和 VIDEO_FILE")
    path = Path(filename)
    if not path.is_file() or not 0 < path.stat().st_size <= 20 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise SystemExit("VIDEO_FILE 必须是非空且不超过 20 MiB 的文件")
    mime = os.environ.get("VIDEO_MIME", "video/mp4")
    allowed = {"video/mp4", "video/mpeg", "video/mov", "video/avi", "video/x-flv",
               "video/mpg", "video/webm", "video/wmv", "video/3gpp"}
    if mime not in allowed:
        raise SystemExit("VIDEO_MIME 不在本页列出的格式范围内")
    video = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    body = {
        "model": "kimi-k3",
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
            {"type": "video_url", "video_url": {"url": f"data:{mime};base64,{video}"}},
            {"type": "text", "text": "概括视频内容，并按顺序列出关键事件。"},
        ]}],
        "reasoning_effort": "low",
        "max_completion_tokens": 4096,
        "stream": False,
    }
    base = os.environ.get("MOONSHOT_BASE_URL", "https://api.moonshot.cn").rstrip("/")
    request = urllib.request.Request(
        base + "/v1/chat/completions", data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"),
        headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + key, "Content-Type": "application/json"},
        method="POST",
    )
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=300) as response:
            result = json.load(response)
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as error:
        raise SystemExit(f"HTTP {error.code}: {error.read().decode('utf-8', errors='replace')}")
    choices = result.get("choices") or []
    if not choices or choices[0].get("finish_reason") != "stop":
        raise RuntimeError("视频分析未正常完成，请检查 finish_reason 与错误信息")
    answer = choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content")
    if not isinstance(answer, str) or not answer.strip():
        raise RuntimeError("响应没有最终文字答案")
    print(answer)
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="Node.js">
    ```javascript
    const { readFile, stat } = require("node:fs/promises");

    async function main() {
      const key = process.env.MOONSHOT_API_KEY;
      const filename = process.env.VIDEO_FILE;
      if (!key || !filename) throw new Error("请设置 MOONSHOT_API_KEY 和 VIDEO_FILE");
      const info = await stat(filename);
      if (!info.isFile() || info.size <= 0 || info.size > 20 * 1024 * 1024)
        throw new Error("VIDEO_FILE 必须是非空且不超过 20 MiB 的文件");
      const mime = process.env.VIDEO_MIME || "video/mp4";
      const allowed = ["video/mp4", "video/mpeg", "video/mov", "video/avi", "video/x-flv",
        "video/mpg", "video/webm", "video/wmv", "video/3gpp"];
      if (!allowed.includes(mime)) throw new Error("不支持的 VIDEO_MIME");
      const video = (await readFile(filename)).toString("base64");
      const body = {
        model: "kimi-k3",
        messages: [{ role: "user", content: [
          { type: "video_url", video_url: { url: `data:${mime};base64,${video}` } },
          { type: "text", text: "概括视频内容，并按顺序列出关键事件。" },
        ] }],
        reasoning_effort: "low", max_completion_tokens: 4096, stream: false,
      };
      const base = (process.env.MOONSHOT_BASE_URL || "https://api.moonshot.cn").replace(/\/+$/, "");
      const response = await fetch(base + "/v1/chat/completions", {
        method: "POST",
        headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${key}`, "Content-Type": "application/json" },
        body: JSON.stringify(body), signal: AbortSignal.timeout(300000),
      });
      if (!response.ok) throw new Error(`HTTP ${response.status}: ${await response.text()}`);
      const result = await response.json();
      const choice = result.choices?.[0];
      if (choice?.finish_reason !== "stop") throw new Error("视频分析未正常完成");
      const answer = choice.message?.content;
      if (typeof answer !== "string" || !answer.trim()) throw new Error("响应没有最终文字答案");
      console.log(answer);
    }
    main().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
    ```
  </Tab>

  <Tab value="curl">
    ```bash
    set -euo pipefail
    : "${MOONSHOT_API_KEY:?请设置 MOONSHOT_API_KEY}"
    : "${VIDEO_FILE:?请设置 VIDEO_FILE}"
    base="${MOONSHOT_BASE_URL:-https://api.moonshot.cn}"
    request=$(mktemp)
    response=$(mktemp)
    trap 'rm -f "$request" "$response"' EXIT
    python3 - <<'PY_BODY' > "$request"
    import base64, json, os
    from pathlib import Path
    path = Path(os.environ["VIDEO_FILE"])
    if not path.is_file() or not 0 < path.stat().st_size <= 20 * 1024 * 1024:
        raise SystemExit("VIDEO_FILE 必须是非空且不超过 20 MiB 的文件")
    mime = os.environ.get("VIDEO_MIME", "video/mp4")
    allowed = {"video/mp4", "video/mpeg", "video/mov", "video/avi", "video/x-flv",
               "video/mpg", "video/webm", "video/wmv", "video/3gpp"}
    if mime not in allowed: raise SystemExit("不支持的 VIDEO_MIME")
    video = base64.b64encode(path.read_bytes()).decode("ascii")
    print(json.dumps({
        "model": "kimi-k3",
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": [
            {"type": "video_url", "video_url": {"url": f"data:{mime};base64,{video}"}},
            {"type": "text", "text": "概括视频内容，并按顺序列出关键事件。"},
        ]}],
        "reasoning_effort": "low", "max_completion_tokens": 4096, "stream": False,
    }, ensure_ascii=False))
    PY_BODY
    if curl --fail-with-body --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 \
      "${base%/}/v1/chat/completions" \
      -H "Authorization: Bearer $MOONSHOT_API_KEY" \
      -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary "@$request" --output "$response"; then
      python3 - "$response" <<'PY_RESULT'
    import json, sys
    with open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8") as source: result = json.load(source)
    choices = result.get("choices") or []
    if not choices or choices[0].get("finish_reason") != "stop":
        raise RuntimeError("视频分析未正常完成")
    answer = choices[0].get("message", {}).get("content")
    if not isinstance(answer, str) or not answer.strip(): raise RuntimeError("响应没有最终文字答案")
    print(answer)
    PY_RESULT
    else
      status=$?
      cat "$response" >&2
      exit "$status"
    fi
    ```

  <Tab value="Go">
    ```go
    package main

    import (
        "bytes"
        "encoding/base64"
        "encoding/json"
        "fmt"
        "io"
        "net/http"
        "os"
        "strings"
        "time"
    )

    func check(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
    func main() {
        key, filename := os.Getenv("MOONSHOT_API_KEY"), os.Getenv("VIDEO_FILE")
        if key == "" || filename == "" { panic("请设置 MOONSHOT_API_KEY 和 VIDEO_FILE") }
        info, err := os.Stat(filename); check(err)
        if !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() <= 0 || info.Size() > 20*1024*1024 {
            panic("VIDEO_FILE 必须是非空且不超过 20 MiB 的文件")
        }
        mime := os.Getenv("VIDEO_MIME"); if mime == "" { mime = "video/mp4" }
        allowed := map[string]bool{"video/mp4":true, "video/mpeg":true, "video/mov":true,
            "video/avi":true, "video/x-flv":true, "video/mpg":true, "video/webm":true,
            "video/wmv":true, "video/3gpp":true}
        if !allowed[mime] { panic("不支持的 VIDEO_MIME") }
        video, err := os.ReadFile(filename); check(err)
        body := map[string]any{
            "model":"kimi-k3",
            "messages":[]any{map[string]any{"role":"user", "content":[]any{
                map[string]any{"type":"video_url", "video_url":map[string]string{
                    "url":"data:"+mime+";base64,"+base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(video)}},
                map[string]string{"type":"text", "text":"概括视频内容，并按顺序列出关键事件。"},
            }}},
            "reasoning_effort":"low", "max_completion_tokens":4096, "stream":false,
        }
        payload, err := json.Marshal(body); check(err)
        base := os.Getenv("MOONSHOT_BASE_URL"); if base == "" { base = "https://api.moonshot.cn" }
        req, err := http.NewRequest("POST", strings.TrimRight(base,"/")+"/v1/chat/completions", bytes.NewReader(payload)); check(err)
        req.Header.Set("Authorization","Bearer "+key); req.Header.Set("Content-Type","application/json")
        res, err := (&http.Client{Timeout:300*time.Second}).Do(req); check(err); defer res.Body.Close()
        raw, err := io.ReadAll(res.Body); check(err)
        if res.StatusCode < 200 || res.StatusCode >= 300 { panic(fmt.Sprintf("HTTP %d: %s",res.StatusCode,raw)) }
        var result struct { Choices []struct {
            Finish string `json:"finish_reason"`
            Message struct { Content string `json:"content"` } `json:"message"`
        } `json:"choices"` }
        check(json.Unmarshal(raw,&result))
        if len(result.Choices)==0 || result.Choices[0].Finish!="stop" { panic("视频分析未正常完成") }
        answer := result.Choices[0].Message.Content
        if strings.TrimSpace(answer)=="" { panic("响应没有最终文字答案") }
        fmt.Println(answer)
    }
    ```

## Errors

| HTTP status           | Common error types                                                                    | Action                                                                                                                 |
| --------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 400                   | `invalid_request_error`, `content_filter`                                             | Check content arrays, Base64/MIME, body size, fixed parameters, and context; adjust input to meet safety requirements. |
| 401                   | `invalid_authentication_error`, `incorrect_api_key_error`                             | Check that the key matches the endpoint’s site; do not mix China, international, or SimiRouter keys.                   |
| 403                   | `permission_denied_error`                                                             | Check model permissions, organization allowlists, and feature availability.                                            |
| 404                   | `resource_not_found_error`                                                            | Verify model IDs, file IDs, and resource ownership.                                                                    |
| 429                   | `engine_overloaded_error`, `exceeded_current_quota_error`, `rate_limit_reached_error` | Distinguish capacity, balance, and rate limits; repeated requests cannot fix insufficient quota.                       |
| 499 / 500 / 503 / 504 | `client_closed_request`, `server_error` and similar errors                            | Retain the request ID and inspect connection/service status; use SSE for long requests where appropriate.              |

Errors usually contain `error.type` and `error.message`; some responses also include `error.code`. A timeout does not prove non-execution. Check usage before retrying, and never log keys or complete video Base64.
